Overdrive IS a specific kind of saturation: when an amplifier or circuit is driven beyond its normal operating range, the peaks are gradually rounded off (soft clipping), which is a form of saturation. A competent speaker would call overdrive 'a kind of saturation'.

Linear-phase filter is designed and implemented for the sake of audio processing practice: it preserves waveform shape and avoids phase distortion in audio signal chains, enabling transparent filtering in music production, mastering, and communications. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

A sample clock provides timing reference for digital audio sampling. Without a clock signal, sampling cannot occur — remove the clock and the sample clock stops operating. This is the removal test: the device literally needs a clock signal to function.

Waveshaping IS a specific kind of saturation technique: it drives a signal through a nonlinear transfer function to create harmonic content. A competent speaker would call waveshaping a saturation method. Nearest kind: saturation (already ACCEPTED). Removal test not needed for INSTANCE_OF — this is a kind-of relationship.
An amplifier's function is to increase the magnitude of a signal. Remove signal and the amplifier has nothing to amplify — its entire purpose and operation is defined by its relationship to signals.

Chorus works by duplicating a signal and adding slight delay variations to create a thickened, multiplied sound. Remove delay and chorus has no mechanism — its core operation is time-delayed signal mixing.

The Nyquist-Shannon sampling theorem was derived from the mathematical foundations of information theory — specifically from Shannon's work on channel capacity and signal representation. The theorem came into existence as a consequence of information-theoretic analysis, making information theory the source from which it was derived.

log-sum-exp IS a specific kind of numerical method — it is a technique for computing log(sum(exp(x))) in a numerically stable way. The nearest kind is numerical-method: a procedure for approximating mathematical computations. Direction is specific→general.

A harmonic exciter generates and adds harmonics (overtones) to a signal to enhance perceived brightness and presence. Its operation depends on harmonics — without the concept of harmonics (integer multiples of a fundamental frequency), the harmonic exciter has nothing to generate or add. The removal test passes: remove harmonics and the harmonic exciter cannot operate.

An isomorphism is a morphism with an inverse: in a category, an isomorphism A → B is a morphism f: A→B for which a morphism g: B→A exists with g∘f = id_A and f∘g = id_B. Every isomorphism is a morphism — a category theorist says 'an isomorphism is a (special) morphism', and the isomorphism's own accepted definition ('a bijective mapping ... with a mapping in the reverse direction') describes exactly a morphism possessing an inverse. Law 11e nearest kind: morphism is the closest existing kind (no function/bijection entry stands nearer). Specific → general.

A desk clamp is designed and maintained for the sake of workshop operations — it secures tools and materials during work. Purpose-based relation: servant (desk-clamp)→master (workshop). Law 8d SERVES.

Removal test against the entry's own accepted definition (Laws 8a/8b): a wah-pedal operates by sweeping the center frequency of a band-pass filter via foot-operated control; remove the band-pass-filter construct and the device has no operating mechanism — no resonant center frequency to sweep, no 'wah' possible (a plain passive box is not a wah-pedal). The band-pass filter is the functional principle the pedal needs to operate, not its identity (the pedal is the device, not the filter) and not its purpose. Pinned sense: the filter as the device's resonant sweep mechanism. Parallel to the accepted wah-wah→band-pass-filter rung for the technique; this is the device-side of the same mechanism.

hindsight-bias's accepted definition pins it as 'a systematic distortion in retrospective memory' whose third parameter is 'a reconstructed memory that shifts the prior state toward certainty or inevitability'. episodic-memory's accepted definition pins the system that encodes and retrieves personal past events, with 'conscious recollectability — the ability to mentally travel back to the encoded experience'. Removal test (Law 8b): remove episodic memory now and there is no encoded past event to retrieve and no reconstruction that could shift the prior state toward certainty — the distortion cannot occur, because it is a failure mode of that system's recollectability, not a process operating beside it. Constitutive, not identity (the bias is the deviation pattern, not the memory system) and not purpose (nothing was built for its sake — that would be SERVES).
Retroduction as a method of inferring the best explanation depends on inference as its cognitive mechanism — without the capacity for inference, retroduction as a reasoning process cannot operate.
MFCC computation applies mel filterbank to magnitude spectrum then takes DCT; removing mel filterbank stops MFCC from operating.

Orthodoxy is a specific kind of belief — conformity to established, accepted doctrine or correct belief. A competent speaker would call orthodoxy 'a type of belief' (specifically, one aligned with accepted doctrine). Nearest kind is belief.

An expander is a specific kind of dynamic-range-processing technique: it increases dynamic range by attenuating signals below a threshold (the inverse of compression). This is a genuine INSTANCE_OF — a competent audio engineer would call an expander 'a dynamic range processing technique.' The nearest kind is dynamic-range-processing (the family of level-dependent variable gain techniques).

Saturation IS a specific kind of distortion: signal overload into nonlinear operation that adds harmonic content. A competent speaker would call saturation a type of distortion. Nearest kind: distortion (ACCEPTED). This is a kind-of relationship, not dependency.

Cepstral peak prominence is built and maintained for speech-recognition: it serves as a per-frame feature descriptor used to classify voicing quality and speaker characteristics in automatic speech recognition pipelines. Remove speech recognition and CPP's primary sustained use-case vanishes.

Information geometry operates exclusively on parametric families of probability distributions (statistical models). Remove the concept of a statistical model and information geometry has no manifold structure to study — the entire framework of statistical manifolds, Fisher metric, and dual connections is defined on the space of statistical models. The removal test passes: X stops operating without Y.

A screwdriver IS a specific kind of hand tool: hand-gripped, hand-driven (grip supplies the torque via the handle as lever). The nearest kind per Laws 9/11e — hand-tool now stands as the operative rung above screwdriver; the older screwdriver→tool rung is subsumed once this ladder accepts. The same object ceases to be a hand tool when a motor drives the bit — the kind tracks mode of operation.

Enumeration (systematic counting) depends on measurement — each count is a measurement of quantity. The removal test: remove measurement and enumeration loses its operative mechanism; counting is measurement by unit increments. Enumeration measures discrete quantity through sequential addition.

Natural gradient computes the update θ_{t+1}=θ_t - η G(θ)^{-1}∇L(θ) where G(θ) is the Fisher information matrix. Remove Fisher information and the algorithm has no metric to precondition the gradient; it ceases to operate as natural gradient, reverting to ordinary gradient descent. Operational removal test per Law 8b.
windowed-sinc-interpolation requires the sinc function as its core kernel; removing sinc eliminates the interpolator's operation. Operational cessation holds.

comparator takes two inputs and determines which is larger, producing an output based on their difference. Remove measurement and the comparator has no function — comparison is measurement in its simplest form. Present-tense dependency.

Limen (threshold of perception) depends on perception — it is the boundary point of perceptual detectability. The removal test: remove perception and the concept of a perceptual threshold ceases to have any meaning. Limen is a parameter OF perception, not independent of it.
Habeas corpus is a specific kind of legal writ that orders a person detaining another to bring the prisoner before a court. A competent speaker calls habeas corpus a type of writ.

A desk-clamp is a specific kind of clamp: a holding device with two jaws drawn together by a screw or cam mechanism to secure objects to a desk edge. Competent speaker would call a desk-clamp 'a clamp' used for desk mounting. Nearest kind is clamp, not fastener directly, per Law 11e. Specific→general.

equalizer is a specific kind of audio-effect: it alters the tonal character of a sound by independently adjusting the amplitude of specific frequency bands. This is intentional sound modification through frequency-domain processing — a core audio-effect that shapes how a sound is perceived spectrally.
A signal-chain is a specific arrangement of processing stages for audio signals — a kind of audio-processing architecture.

Bias-variance decomposition partitions the expected squared error of an estimator into bias², variance, and noise terms. All three components are defined relative to a statistical model p(x|θ) with its estimator f̂. Remove the statistical model framework and the decomposition has no estimators, no parameters, and no expected values — it stops operating.
Ring modulation multiplies two oscillator signals to produce sum and difference tones. Remove oscillator sources and the modulator has no input to operate on; the effect ceases.

Amplitude modulation is a specific signal processing technique for varying carrier amplitude. Competent speaker test: amplitude modulation is a kind of signal processing. Specific→general, nearest kind.

Compressor is a specific kind of audio effect: it reduces the dynamic range of a signal by automatically lowering gain when the signal exceeds a threshold. Direction: compressor (newer, 1940s recording technique) INSTANCE_OF audio-effect (older, foundational). Nearest kind per Law 11e.

Phase vocoder is a time-frequency analysis/synthesis technique built for the sake of speech and audio manipulation — pitch shifting, time stretching, and phase-coherent reconstruction that improve perceived quality and intelligibility. Its designed purpose is to serve speech enhancement workflows that require phase-aware processing. Servant points at master per Law 8d.
Ordinals are a specific type of number used to represent position in an ordered sequence (first, second, third, etc.). Ordinal numbers are a kind of number, distinct from cardinal numbers.

A flanger is a specific audio modulation effect that mixes a signal with a delayed copy of itself where the delay time is varied by a low-frequency oscillator. Competent speaker test: flanger is a kind of modulation effect. Specific→general, nearest kind.

A clipper is a specific kind of dynamic-range-processing: it limits the peak amplitude of a signal by clipping waveforms that exceed a threshold. Competent speaker test: a clipper is a type of dynamic range processor. Nearest kind: dynamic-range-processing (not a leap — clipper is directly a kind of dynamic range control). Law 9 passes.

The burden of proof is a rule that exists within legal systems — it dictates which party must produce evidence and persuade the trier of fact. Remove law and the burden of proof ceases to have any operative force.

Mid-side processing encodes stereo signals as mid+side components for processing. This requires a signal-chain as the operating substrate — remove the signal path and mid-side processing cannot execute on any audio signals. Constitutive present-tense dependency.

skepticism IS a kind of critical-thinking: both are evaluative cognitive practices. Skepticism specifically involves questioning and doubt as a method; critical-thinking is the broader practice of careful, objective analysis. Pinned sense: skepticism as an instance of the general critical-evaluation practice.

A comparator IS a specific kind of instrument: it is a device or system designed to compare two or more values, signals, or quantities and produce a result based on their relationship. A competent engineer or scientist would classify a comparator as an instrument.

Pinned sense: estoppel is a specific body of enforceable legal rules — a doctrine barring a party from asserting a fact or right contradicting their prior position, enforced by courts and sustained through precedent (per the entry's accepted definition). Against the target's accepted definition — 'explicit, enforceable rules that bind conduct within a recognized jurisdiction, persisting through courts' — estoppel is a cluster of exactly such rules: explicit elements (representation, reliance, detriment), enforceable (courts apply it), conduct-binding (bars the contradicted claim). Nearest existing kind: no 'doctrine' entry exists, so 'law' is the nearest rung (Law 11e). Distinct from the already-accepted estoppel DEPENDS_ON law (operational reliance on the enforcement system) — kind-membership is a separate relation.

A partial dependence plot is a visualization technique specifically designed for interpreting machine learning models. Its entire purpose and operation depend on ML: it shows the relationship between predicted outcomes from a trained model and feature values. Remove machine learning — no trained model, no predictions to visualize, no marginal effects to compute — and the partial dependence plot ceases to operate. The removal test is satisfied: without ML, a PDP has no function.

The bias-variance decomposition breaks prediction error into bias, variance, and irreducible error components. This decomposition serves model selection by guiding the choice of model complexity — helping practitioners navigate the bias-variance tradeoff to select models that generalize well. Law 8d: servant (decomposition) points at master (model selection).

Predictive distribution is defined as marginalizing likelihood p(x_new|θ) over posterior p(θ|x). Removing the posterior removes the integration kernel; the predictive distribution cannot be computed or operated as a Bayesian forecast. Operational cessation, not conceptual sayability.

probit-model relies on statistical-inference methods (parameter estimation, hypothesis testing, confidence intervals) to operate. Remove statistical-inference and the model loses its purpose of drawing conclusions from data — it stops operating as an inferential tool.
An audio-interface is a specific kind of audio-processing device: it converts analog to digital audio signals as part of processing workflow. Nearest kind is audio-processing.
A state-space-model IS a specific kind of mathematical model that represents systems through state equations. State→kind-of-pointing: a state-space model is a model.

Analogical reasoning operates by mapping similarities across domains — it requires comparison as its constitutive mechanism. Remove comparison (the operation of noting similarities/differences between entities) and analogical reasoning cannot function at all. This is object-level: comparison is not a meta-level condition shared by all concepts, but a specific cognitive operation that analogical reasoning performs. The removal test passes: without comparison, the reasoning process stops working.

rationalization needs self-deception to operate: the psychological mechanism functions by deceiving oneself about motives. Remove self-deception and rationalization cannot work — the mechanism collapses. The removal test passes.
Spectral subtraction is a noise reduction technique designed for the purpose of improving speech intelligibility and quality, i.e., serving speech enhancement.

Removal test: remove cognitive biases (systematic patterns of deviation from rational judgment like availability heuristic, confirmation bias, categorization) and stereotypes — rigid overgeneralized beliefs about groups — lose their psychological mechanism. Stereotypes form and persist through cognitive biases; without them, the mental shortcuts that produce stereotyping cease. The mechanism is cognitive bias; the output is stereotype content.

Headroom IS a specific kind of saturation phenomenon: it is the margin between nominal operating level and the point where saturation/clipping begins. Headroom defines the boundary of the saturation zone. Direction: specific (headroom = the margin before saturation) → general (saturation = operation at capacity limit).

Elaborative interrogation is a specific learning strategy that connects new information to existing knowledge through self-generated questioning. It is a kind of cognitive strategy — a structured mental operation for processing information. Pinned sense: learning technique as a category of cognitive strategy.

Categorization operates by matching inputs against stored patterns. Remove memory and there is no stored category to match — categorization stops operating entirely. This is constitutive: categorization requires a memory mechanism to store and retrieve category definitions. The removal test passes operationally, not just conceptually.

Speech intelligibility measures how well spoken language is understood. It depends on psychoacoustics — the study of how the auditory system processes sound — because without psychoacoustic models of human hearing, speech intelligibility cannot be properly measured or predicted.

A preamp DEPENDS_ON gain: the removal test passes — remove the concept of gain (the ratio of output to input amplitude), and a preamp ceases to operate because its sole purpose is to provide gain to a weak signal. Without the concept of gain, amplification has no operational meaning and the preamp has no function.

Sunk-cost-fallacy is a specific kind of fallacy: it is the error of continuing an endeavor because of previously invested resources rather than future expected value. The accepted fallacy definition covers this as a reasoning error, and sunk-cost-fallacy is a particular pattern of such error. Direction: specific instance → general category.

An exemplar is a specific kind of prototype — one that serves as a model or example for others to follow. A prototype is the broader concept of an initial or representative model; an exemplar is prototype-as-ideal-pattern. A competent speaker would call an exemplar 'a type of prototype.'

Limiting is an audio processing technique designed to reduce the dynamic range of an audio signal. It is built for the sake of audio-engineering applications: preventing overload, controlling peaks in mixing/mastering, and protecting equipment. Servant (limiting) points at master (audio-engineering) per Law 8d.

Speech intelligibility is measured through acoustic analysis using signal processing techniques — spectral analysis, SNR computation, and weighting algorithms. Remove signal processing and there is no mechanism to compute or measure speech intelligibility. Constitutive dependency.

A proviso is a specific type of stipulation — a condition or qualification attached to a legal document or agreement. A competent speaker would call a proviso 'a stipulation.' INSTANCE_OF: specific legal condition → general category.

Sidechain is a specific kind of signal-processing technique: it processes signals by routing one signal to control the processing of another. A competent engineer would call sidechaining a form of signal processing. The nearest kind is signal-processing — broader categories like 'audio technique' or 'method' would be leaps when signal-processing already exists and captures the technical essence.

Mask-based enhancement operates on time-frequency representations to estimate masks and apply them to magnitude spectra. Remove STFT and the mask estimation and application cannot operate — the technique stops functioning. Operational dependency per Law 8b, not merely sayable. Remove-Y-now-X-stops-operating test satisfied.

An erratum list is a specific kind of editorial apparatus: a published list of corrections to a text, appended as an adjunct that frames and presents the work to readers (telling them which passages to read as corrected). Paratext's accepted definition names exactly this class — 'titles, covers, marginalia, footnotes, forewords, blurbs, and editorial conventions that frames and presents a text' — and errata notices are a standard member of that apparatus in publishing practice. Law 9: a specific editorial element is a specific kind of paratext. Nearest kind per Law 11e: paratext is the nearest live rung (no 'correction-list' or 'erratum' entry exists); the 'book' it attaches to is the host, not the kind.

Cepstral peak prominence is a signal processing feature — its computation (FFT → log-spectrum → IFFT → peak detection) requires the framework of signal processing. Remove signal processing and CPP has no operating mechanism. The removal test passes. Direction: cepstral-peak-prominence→signal-processing.

A compendium IS a specific kind of compilation. Both my own accepted definitions line up: compendium is 'a curated collection of concise information... a stable compiled form', and compilation carves 'curated collections' assembled under editorial judgment. A competent speaker calls a compendium a kind of compilation (curated, compiled, reference). Direction specific→general, Law 9. This complements (does not duplicate) compendium INSTANCE_OF encyclopedia: encyclopedia is the content/organization axis, compilation is the construction-method axis. Target is light — compilation has only two incoming INSTANCE_OF edges.

A treatise is a specific kind of discourse: its own accepted definition names it 'a formal, systematic written discourse on a subject' - a genre of conventionally structured communication (systematic, thesis-organized, comprehensive) operating under the scholarly community's rules of relevance and evidentiary standard, persisted through publication, citation, and canonical maintenance. Pinned sense: treatise as discourse-genre. Nearest kind on the communicative axis: discourse (ACCEPTED), the same axis as the accepted digression->discourse and problematization->discourse edges. This complements, not duplicates, the accepted treatise->book form classification: book carves the physical/document form, discourse carves the communicative kind.

STFT is the core analysis tool that speech enhancement algorithms depend on — spectral subtraction, Wiener filtering, and mask-based enhancement all operate on STFT-derived time-frequency representations. Remove STFT and these speech enhancement methods stop functioning. Operational dependency per Law 8b.

Saturation DEPENDS_ON gain: the removal test passes — saturation (in audio, the soft clipping that occurs when signal levels exceed a circuit's capacity) is achieved by driving gain beyond the design limit. Remove gain as a concept, and saturation ceases to operate because saturation IS the result of excessive gain; without gain there is no mechanism for saturation.

All real-time pitch-shifting techniques (resampling, phase-vocoder, granular synthesis) rely on sampling — the discretization of a continuous signal into time-stamped numerical values. Remove sampling and these mechanisms cannot operate: a pitch-shifter has no way to process or reconstruct audio. Passes Law 8 removal test.

MLE is fundamentally defined as argmax_θ L(θ|x) — the likelihood function is its constitutive input. Remove likelihood and MLE has no mathematical object to maximize. Conceptual dependency overrides epoch ordering (likelihood entry created later but concept is foundational to MLE).

oscillator is a specific kind of audio-effect device: it generates a repeating electronic waveform (sine, square, sawtooth, triangle) used as a sound source in synthesis. When used as a sound-producing instrument in an audio system, it qualifies as an audio-effect — a tool that produces or transforms sound intentionally.

Remove oscillator and an LFO cannot operate — an LFO is a low-frequency oscillator whose periodic output drives modulation parameters. Without the oscillator mechanism (periodic signal generation), the LFO has no means of producing its characteristic repeating waveform.

Removal test (Laws 2b/8b): remove the technique of signal amplification — the process by which an electronic circuit uses external power to produce an output whose amplitude is a scaled version of the input — and the amplifier stops operating: a circuit that cannot amplify is not an amplifier but merely a passive network. This is the screwdriver→leverage pattern: the device depends on the functional process it instantiates. Not INSTANCE_OF — an amplifier is not a kind of amplification (it is a device, not a process). Not SERVES — the amplifier is not built for another master's sake; it is the thing that performs the process. Pinned sense: signal-amplification as the amplifying process per its accepted definition (active devices modulating an external supply in sympathy with the input).
Jurisdiction is a specific legal concept defining the scope of authority within the law. Clean specific→general INSTANCE_OF (Law 9).

Formant vocoder is built for the sake of the vocoder — it implements the vocoder's purpose (speech analysis and synthesis) using the specific mechanism of formant frequency modeling. The formant vocoder serves the broader class of vocoders by providing a particular approach to voice transformation.

Clipper is an audio processing effect that aggressively limits the amplitude of a signal above a threshold, producing harmonic distortion. It is built for the sake of audio-engineering: creative sound design, guitar effects, and loudness optimization in mixing. Servant (clipper) points at master (audio-engineering) per Law 8d.

scientific-method DEPENDS_ON idealization: the scientific method requires idealization to build tractable models of complex reality (perfect gases, frictionless surfaces, rational agents). Remove idealization and the scientific method loses its primary tool for rendering systems analyzable — it cannot operate at full capacity without abstraction through idealized models.

reverb DEPENDS_ON reflection: reverb IS the accumulation of sound reflections off surfaces in an enclosure. Remove reflections — no physical surfaces to bounce sound — and reverb ceases to operate. This is a constitutive dependency, not merely sayable: reverb's mechanism IS reflection. Ladder: N/A.

Elaborative-interrogation operates through language as its constitutive medium: the learner generates explanatory answers using verbal or written language. Remove language and the technique has no vehicle for generating explanations — it ceases to operate. This is object-level dependency (language as operational material), not meta-level (language as shared condition of all concepts). The definition explicitly cites 'semantic elaboration' — semantic content requires language.

Removal test (Laws 2b/8b): remove the LFO and the periodic pitch variation disappears — without the low-frequency oscillator modulating the source's pitch there is only static pitch, not vibrato. The LFO definition names exactly this use: 'pitch (vibrato)' alongside 'amplitude (tremolo)', 'gain (ring modulation)', 'delay time (flanger)'. This is the pitch-domain twin of the ALREADY ACCEPTED tremolo DEPENDS_ON lfo edge — same pattern, different pair, completing the LFO's four named uses. Not merely 'sayable about' (ambient): the LFO is the operative component generating the effect's defining parameter variation. Direction tested: vibrato (dependent) → lfo (dependency).

The garden hoe is a hand tool whose design and purpose emerged from agricultural practice. Agriculture (the practice of cultivating soil and growing crops) predates the garden hoe as an organized activity, and the tool was developed within that practice. Test: agriculture existed first and fed into the garden hoe.

Pinned sense: synthesizer AS A MUSICAL INSTRUMENT (sound source). The target's accepted definition explicitly carves 'musical ... instruments' as members of the kind. A synthesizer is a human-made device for controlled operation in a specialized musical domain (performance input → generated sound), requiring calibration (tuning, oscillator stability) — the instrument boundary the definition draws against general tools. Not pinned to its signal-processing internals (it already carries the accepted DEPENDS_ON→oscillator rung for that). Nearest kind on the board: no musical-instrument node exists.

Estoppel is a specific equitable doctrine that prevents a party from asserting a claim or right that contradicts their prior statements, conduct, or established judgments. It files against equity as the nearest kind — estoppel is one of the specific doctrines within the equitable body of law, not law generally (which would be a leap). Sense pinned: estoppel as the preventing doctrine in common law, not the colloquial sense of forbidding.

A compendium is a systematic collection of knowledge on a subject, organized for reference. It is built for the sake of knowledge management — providing structured, retrievable organization of information across a domain.

Ring modulation multiplies an input signal by a carrier waveform to produce sum and difference frequencies (sidebands). This is a specific kind of frequency-modulation where the modulation is multiplicative and the modulator amplitude is fixed (not variable like in standard FM). A competent speaker would call ring-modulation 'a kind of frequency modulation' — it operates by shifting frequency content.

Phase coherence is a specific signal-processing property used to quantify consistency of phase relationships in audio signals. It is a kind of signal-processing metric, specific→general. Law 9 satisfied.
A typology is a specific cognitive framework for classifying and organizing concepts. Clean specific→general INSTANCE_OF (Law 9). Typologies are made by cognition for cognition.

The likelihood function L(θ|x) = p(x|θ) IS the statistical model evaluated at the observed data. Remove the statistical model and the likelihood has no mathematical definition — there is no p(x|θ) without a model family. The model specifies the parametric family; the likelihood is the model read as a function of θ for fixed x. Operational cessation: without the model, the likelihood ceases to exist as a mathematical object. Direction correct: likelihood is the derived object, model is the foundational one.

Stipulation is a specific kind of provision — a term or condition set by authority as part of an agreement or rule. A competent speaker would call it 'a type of provision' (one imposed rather than negotiated). Nearest kind is provision.

Rényi entropy (1961) was introduced as a one-parameter generalization of Shannon entropy (1948). Shannon entropy is the α→1 limit of Rényi's formula. Historical: Shannon existed first and fed into Rényi's generalization.

gloss IS a specific kind of rhetorical figure: a pattern of language where a word or phrase is followed by an explanatory restatement that clarifies or disambiguates. Per the gloss definition itself: 'a rhetorical figure in which a word or phrase is followed by an explanation.' The competent speaker test passes — rhetoric scholars classify gloss as a figure of speech/rhetoric. Nearest kind: rhetorical-figure (accepted). Pinned sense: gloss as a rhetorical/literary figure, not gloss as a general annotation.

Scholia (plural of scholium) are a specific historical form of annotation — learned marginal or interlinear notes on classical texts. The practice of scholia derives from the broader, older practice of annotation. Annotation came first and fed into the scholarly tradition of scholia.

Rényi divergence is derived from the power-divergence family: both share the same building block Σ p^α q^(1-α), with Rényi applying a log transform (1/(α-1) log[...]) while power divergence uses the raw polynomial form (1/(α(α-1))) Σ(...). Rényi is a transformation of the power-divergence kernel.
minimum-phase filters are designed to preserve temporal alignment in audio processing, serving speech enhancement by reducing phase distortion.

Model averaging as a statistical technique was historically derived from statistics: the concept of weighting models by their likelihood or information criteria (AIC, BIC) derives from statistical theory (Fisher 1920s, Akaike 1970s). Statistics existed first and fed into model averaging.

Pitch-shift is built and maintained for the sake of digital-audio applications — music production, voice conversion, and sound design all depend on pitch manipulation. Remove pitch-shift and these audio workflows lose a core capability. The servant points at the master: pitch-shift serves digital-audio.

Epistemic rationality is a specific kind of rationality focused on belief formation and evidence evaluation; rationality is the general class of reasoning aimed at truth or coherence. The specific points to the general, not the reverse.

A sampler records audio segments into digital memory and replays them; without storage the samples cannot be retained for later playback, so the sampler stops operating as a sampler. Remove storage now and the device cannot fulfill its sample-replay function.
A quorum is a specific procedural rule within law and governance for establishing minimum participation. Clean specific→general INSTANCE_OF (Law 9).

The scientific method depends on falsifiability as its defining criterion — remove falsifiability and the method loses its ability to distinguish testable claims from non-testable ones. Present-tense constitutive dependency: the method stops operating as science without this criterion. Per Law 8b, removing falsifiability doesn't just stop the concept from being sayable — it stops the scientific method's operational function (testing and refuting hypotheses).

Removal test (Law 8): a wah-wah cannot operate without a bandpass filter — the entire mechanism IS the sweeping of the filter's center frequency. Remove the bandpass-filter construct and the wah-wah has no working mechanism. The edge tests object-level operation, not sayability (Law 8b). Direction: wah-wah (dependent) -> band-pass-filter (dependency).

A commentary is a specific kind of annotation — it consists of explanatory or critical notes added to a text. An annotation is a general category of explanatory notes; commentary is a specific form of annotation that provides sustained critical engagement with source material. 'Book' exists as an entry and 'annotation' exists as an entry.

Formant vocoder is built and maintained for the sake of speech enhancement tasks such as intelligibility improvement and voice conversion. Its design purpose is to manipulate formant structure to enhance perceived speech quality.

Mel-cepstral distortion is a perceptual metric designed and maintained to quantify distance between reference and processed speech, used specifically to evaluate and guide speech recognition systems; its construction serves the purpose of assessing recognition performance.

Rényi entropy (1961) was introduced as a one-parameter generalization of Shannon entropy (1948). Shannon entropy is the α→1 limit of the Rényi formula. Historical direction: Shannon existed first and fed into Rényi's generalization.

dynamic-range-processing operates on audio signals to control amplitude over time. Remove signal and dynamic-range-processing has nothing to process, no levels to compress/expand/limit/gate. Operational removal test passes: the processing chain ceases to function without a signal to act upon.

Jensen-Shannon divergence JS(P||Q) = 0.5·KL(P||M) + 0.5·KL(Q||M) is a specific functional mapping two probability distributions to a non-negative real number. It satisfies the defining properties of statistical divergence: non-negativity, JS=0 iff P=Q a.e., and symmetry. A competent speaker would classify Jensen-Shannon as a type of statistical divergence. Nearest kind is statistical-divergence.

Headroom is the margin between nominal operating level and maximum capacity before clipping. It depends on amplifier: remove amplification systems and the concept of headroom (as a measurable margin in signal processing) ceases to operate.

Retroduction (abductive reasoning) as a named form of reasoning was derived from the broader concept of inference. Historically, inference came first as the general process; retroduction was carved out as a distinct type.

A noise-gate is an audio-effect that attenuates or mutes a signal when its level falls below a set threshold. Like distortion and equalizer, it is a specific kind of audio processing device/algorithm applied to an audio signal to modify its character — specifically by removing signals below threshold. A competent speaker would call it 'a kind of audio effect'.

impedance IS a specific kind of property: it is the measure of opposition to current flow in an electrical circuit. A competent speaker in electronics would call impedance a type of property — specifically, an electrical property. Ladder: property is the nearest general kind.

bit-crusher reduces bit depth and/or sample rate to create distortion artifacts. Remove sampling and the bit-crusher has no data to process — it operates directly on sampled signals. The removal test passes.

headroom IS a specific kind of measurement: it quantifies the difference between the nominal operating level and the maximum level before clipping or distortion in audio systems. A competent audio engineer would call headroom a type of measurement — specifically, the measurement of margin above normal operating level. Ladder: measurement is the nearest general kind.

MLE finds θ̂ by optimizing the likelihood function L(θ|x) or equivalently its log l(θ|x). Remove likelihood-function and MLE has no mathematical object to optimize — the entire estimation procedure ceases to exist. Direction correct: MLE (epoch 0.03) depends on likelihood-function (epoch 0.01), the foundational object. The likelihood function is the constitutive mathematical ingredient of MLE.

Dialectic operates through structured argumentation — premises, inferences, and conclusions. Remove logic (the study and principles of valid reasoning) and dialectic loses its framework for distinguishing valid from invalid arguments. The method's core operations of premise evaluation and inference checking require logic to function.

Burden of proof is the rule that dictates which party must produce evidence. It operates through logical reasoning — the evaluation of evidence, the assignment of responsibility for proof. Remove logic and burden of proof stops operating: there is no framework to reason about evidence, no logical structure to assign the burden. The removal test passes.
MCD is computed from mel-cepstral coefficients derived via mel-filterbank analysis of the spectrum. Remove mel-filterbank and the cepstral coefficients cannot be formed, so MCD stops operating.

CPP measures the prominence of peaks in the cepstrum, which directly correlates with pitch periodicity — a core prosodic dimension. Speech prosody analysis uses CPP as a feature to quantify intonation, stress, and rhythmic properties. The metric serves prosody research by providing a quantitative measure of periodic structure.

Spectral processing is a human-made technique built and maintained for the sake of audio engineering practice: it enables frequency-domain analysis, spectral editing, and frequency-targeted manipulation used in mixing, mastering, and sound design. Servant points at master per Law 8d. Consistent with accepted SERVES edges from phase-vocoder→audio-engineering, formant-warping→audio-engineering.

Log-likelihood is only defined relative to a statistical model: the likelihood function L(θ|data) = P(data|model, θ). Remove the statistical model and log-likelihood has no meaning — the probability function requires a model specification. Constitutive dependency (Law 8).

Amplifier (as used in audio signal processing) IS a specific kind of audio-effect: it modifies a signal by increasing its amplitude, which is a form of deliberate sound modification through signal processing. While amplifiers also exist outside audio (RF, power), the entry in this context is an audio processing tool. A competent speaker would call an audio amplifier a type of audio-effect. Nearest kind: audio-effect.
Remove the audio signal and the dynamic-range-meter has no input to measure; its display freezes or reads no level, so it stops operating.

sample-clock provides periodic timing reference that governs sampling instants for ADC/DAC in audio-processing chains. It is built as a timing source for the sake of maintaining sample-accurate operation of processing blocks; without its periodic signal, sample-accurate processing cannot be maintained.

Spatialization DEPENDS_ON signal because it operates on audio signals — its definition explicitly uses signal processing techniques (HRTF convolution, ambisonic sphere encoding, spatial panning) as its mechanism. Remove signals and spatialization has no medium to process: no signal means nothing to spatialize. Removal test passes at the object level.

Law 10 whole-and-part. Grammar's own accepted definition carves it as 'the human-made system of rules and patterns that govern the structure and combination of elements WITHIN a language', explicitly distinct from the lexicon (vocabulary) and from usage. So a language decomposes into grammar + lexicon (+ pragmatic deployment): grammar is a component sitting inside the whole language, the way a car contains an engine. This is the part-whole relation, not a kind relation (a competent speaker does not call grammar 'a kind of language' — that is the pending INSTANCE_OF, which I am striking) and not a dependency claim (grammar DEPENDS_ON language already stands and is accepted: remove the language and there are no elements for the rules to govern).

EM's E-step computes Q(θ|θ^(t)) = E[log p(x,z|θ)] — the expected complete-data log-likelihood. The M-step maximizes this over θ. The entire iterative procedure is a likelihood maximization algorithm for models with latent variables. Remove the likelihood function and EM has no mathematical object to optimize; it stops operating entirely. Constitutive present-tense dependency (Law 8b/8c).
Audio jitter is studied and managed to improve audio processing quality, its measurement serves the practice

Removal test (Laws 2b/8b): the screwdriver's accepted carve is 'engineered to rotate a screw fastener through a driven tip,' with tip geometry (flat, Phillips, Torx) matched to the screw head. Remove the screw and the mechanism has nothing to engage — the driven tip cannot perform its driving action and the tip geometries become meaningless; the tool ceases to operate as a screwdriver. Not purpose (8c): the screw is not what the screwdriver is FOR (that is the user's fastening task, which would be SERVES); the screw is the object the mechanism acts upon. Not identity: screw and screwdriver are distinct constructs with independent histories and uses (a screw fastens without a screwdriver present; a screwdriver drives without being a screw).

The exponential-family is defined by the canonical form p(x|η) = h(x) exp(η·T(x) − A(η)) where T(x) is the sufficient-statistic vector. Remove the concept of sufficient statistics and the exponential family's definition collapses — it has no meaning without T(x). This is a constitutive dependency, not incidental use.

Pinned sense: the corpus as INPUT the mechanism processes, not display substrate. The word cloud's accepted definition fixes parameter (1) as 'a collection of tokens from a text corpus with associated counts or weights' and its core mechanism as mapping those counts to font size. Removal test (Law 8b): remove the corpus — the bounded collection of texts assembled for analysis — and there are no tokens to count, no frequencies to map, and nothing for the encoding to act on; the construct's own persistence carriers (text-analysis dashboards, editorial graphics, charting libraries) are pipelines that consume text collections. Functional→input dependency in which removal halts the mechanism, same shape as variance→probability-distribution, not a medium-in-which appeal.

An amplifier's function is to increase the amplitude of an input signal. Signal is its material medium — remove signal and the amplifier has nothing to amplify, ceasing to operate. Object-level dependency (consistent with speaker→signal and DAC→signal, all accepting signal as material). The definition explicitly describes input/output signal operations.

Gain-staging IS a specific kind of audio engineering practice — the discipline of maintaining optimal signal levels across a processing chain. Direction: specific→general per Law 9. A competent speaker classifies gain-staging as a form of audio engineering. Nearest kind: audio-engineering (ACCEPTED).

SERVES = for-whose-sake (Law 8d): a statistical estimator — a rule mapping a sample to an estimate — is built for the sake of estimation, the procedure of determining approximate values from partial information. Remove the estimand/estimation goal and the rule is just a function with no purpose. Servant points at master; no dependency claimed (estimation operates without any one estimator).

Clipping as an audio processing technique truncates signal peaks at a defined threshold level. Remove the concept of a threshold — a defined crossing point that mediates between states — and clipping ceases to operate: there is no boundary against which to clip. Present-tense removal test passes. This is the same structural dependency as compressor DEPENDS_ON threshold.

Collation is the specific practice of gathering and assembling dispersed sources (texts, records, data) into a unified collection. It is a form of bibliographic work focused on bringing together materials for comparison or comprehensive study.

Remove signal-processing and an oscillator cannot operate — an oscillator sustains periodic output from steady power through feedback mechanisms. The oscillation mechanism (amplifier with feedback network) is a signal-processing operation: converting DC power into a controlled periodic waveform.

spectral-processing needs fourier-transform to operate NOW: removing the Fourier transform (or its computational variant, FFT) means spectral analysis is impossible — there is no alternative mechanism for converting between time-domain and frequency-domain representations. This is an operational dependency, not a conceptual one: spectral processing literally cannot execute its core function without the transform algorithm.
Expander widens dynamic range by attenuating signals below threshold. Built for audio-processing. Servant→master per Law 8d.
Biquad-filter is a specific kind of filter (second-order IIR section with two poles and two zeros). A competent speaker would call it 'a filter'. Nearest general kind: filter.

Conceptualization is a specific kind of process — the cognitive/epistemic process of forming concepts. It involves organizing information, identifying patterns, and creating mental categories. A competent speaker would say 'conceptualization is a process.' The nearest kind is process, not concept (which would be Law 9a: a thing is not an instance of its own property).
Spectral-flanger applies time-varying comb filtering in frequency domain via STFT analysis and resynthesis; remove STFT and the effect has no spectral bins to modulate, ceasing operation.

Distortion DEPENDS_ON gain as its operational mechanism: the accepted definition states 'driving an electronic signal beyond the linear operating range' which requires applying gain to push the signal past the linear threshold. Remove gain and distortion has no way to drive the signal into non-linear territory. Direction: distortion (dependent) → gain (operand), per Law 8b removal test.

Removal test (Law 8): a phaser cannot operate without all-pass filters — the entire mechanism IS the phase-shifted signal path created by all-pass filter cascades. Remove the all-pass-filter construct and the phaser has no working mechanism. The edge tests object-level operation, not sayability (Law 8b). Direction: phaser (dependent) -> all-pass-filter (dependency).

Mel-cepstral distortion is a metric computed from mel-frequency cepstral coefficients to quantify spectral distortion between reference and processed speech; it is built for the sake of evaluating and improving speech recognition and synthesis systems.
audio-clock-drift is a specific kind of error in audio systems where oscillator timing diverges; a competent speaker would call it 'a kind of timing error'

Pinned sense: the standard all-pass section is a specific kind of IIR filter. Its discrete-time form H(z) = (a + z^-1)/(1 + a z^-1) places a pole inside the unit circle with its zero at the reciprocal radius outside — precisely the feedback structure that gives IIR filters their infinite-duration impulse response; a nontrivial exact all-pass (unity magnitude for all frequency) cannot be realized as an FIR, only pure delays. A competent DSP speaker calls an all-pass section an IIR filter. Nearest kind on the board is iir-filter; 'filter' would leap two rungs up the ladder (Law 11e). Direction: specific all-pass -> general iir-filter, per Law 9.

Sample-rate is a parameter and practice built for the sake of audio engineering: engineers choose sample rates to balance bandwidth, aliasing, and storage, and the entire recording/monitoring workflow is organized around the chosen rate. The concept exists to serve engineering decisions about fidelity and compatibility.

Skepticism as a philosophical practice depends on epistemology — the study of knowledge, belief, and justification. The removal test: without epistemological frameworks (what counts as knowledge, criteria for justification), skepticism has no conceptual apparatus to operate. Remove epistemology and skepticism collapses into mere doubt without methodology.

Input validation checks whether input data satisfies expected constraints and conditions. It depends on logic — the evaluation of input conditions is fundamentally logical (boolean expressions, type checking, constraint satisfaction). Without logic, input validation cannot determine whether input is valid.

Digital reverb implementations are built from delay-line structures: comb filters (for periodic reflections/decay) and allpass filters (for diffusion) both use delay-line buffers. Remove delay-line as a construct and Schroeder reverb, FDN reverb, and convolution reverb all cease to operate — the delay-line is the constitutive mechanism, not just the domain.
Butterworth filter design is built for the sake of speech enhancement pipelines that need maximally-flat magnitude response for noise shaping and equalization. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

Falsifiability as a criterion depends on scientific method for its role — without the framework of hypothesis testing that defines scientific method, falsifiability cannot function as a demarcation criterion.

Upward-expansion (boosting signals below threshold) is the inverse operation of compression (reducing signals above threshold). Remove compression as a concept and upward-expansion loses its conceptual counterpart in the expansion family. The removal test: without the concept of dynamic range compression/expansion, upward-expansion has no operational category. It is a type of compression/expansion processor.

Phase-vocoder is a signal-processing algorithm constructed specifically to enable independent control of pitch and time scale, and is the canonical method used for pitch shifting in audio. Servant→master.
Cepstral analysis computes cepstral coefficients via DCT of the log-power spectrum; removing DCT stops the computation pipeline. Present-tense dependency: DCT is a constitutive step.

garden hoe is a specific kind of hand tool — a handheld agricultural implement with a flat blade. The 'is a kind of' test passes: a competent speaker would call it 'a hand tool.' Direction: garden hoe→hand-tool.

A Kalman filter requires a state-space model to operate: remove the state-space model (state equations + observation equations) and the Kalman filter has no structure to recurse upon. The filter operates ON the model — without it, the recursive update stops. Present-tense necessity, Law 8.
A subpoena is a specific type of legal document: a court order compelling someone to appear in court or produce evidence. 'Is a subpoena a type of legal document?' Yes. Nearest kind: legal document.

stereo IS a specific kind of audio-processing: it is a technique for spatial sound reproduction using multiple channels, which is an operation performed on audio signals. A competent speaker would call stereo 'a kind of audio processing.' Pinned sense: stereo as a sound reproduction technique (not the adjective). Direction: specific→general per Law 9. Nearest kind per Law 11e.

A crossover is a specific kind of filter: it selectively passes designated frequency bands (routed to a driver) while attenuating the rest, per a designed transfer function — precisely a filter's function, specialized to band-splitting. 'filter' is the nearest available kind (no band-splitter/multiway-filter entry exists), so this is not a leapy INSTANCE_OF. specific->general (Law 9/11e).

Removal test in the pinned sense: the score function U(theta;x) is defined as the gradient of the log-likelihood, U = d/dtheta log L(theta;x) (its accepted definition says so explicitly). Remove log-likelihood and U has no mathematical object to differentiate -- the score is undefined. Fisher information is then its negative expected Hessian, so the whole MLE curvature machinery runs on the log-likelihood. Direction matches the note; functional->input pattern.

Information geometry provides the Fisher information metric and dual affine connections as tools for analyzing statistical models and inference procedures. It serves statistical inference by giving geometric structure to families of probability distributions, enabling cleaner analysis of estimation, hypothesis testing, and model comparison.
Signal-amplification IS a specific kind of amplification: it increases the amplitude of a signal. A competent speaker classifies it as 'a kind of amplification' — the nearest kind per Law 9.

A delay-line needs memory to store samples: remove the memory and the delay-line cannot hold any sample, thus cannot delay anything. Its entire operating mechanism requires memory to persist signal values over time.

parallel-compression splits audio into parallel paths, applies different compression ratios, then recombines. Remove signal-processing and the technique has no operation. Present-tense dependency, not mere historical association.

Explicit (in audio/music release context) IS a type of annotation — a classification label attached to content indicating presence of explicit material (profanity, violence, etc.). A competent speaker calls explicit an annotation or label on content.

Harmonic exciter generates additional harmonics by applying saturation to the input signal; remove saturation and the harmonic generation stops operating, as the exciter's mechanism is saturation-based harmonic generation.

The ELBO's defining identity log p(x) = L(q) + KL(q||p) means L(q) = log p(x) - KL(q||p). Remove KL-divergence and the ELBO operational definition collapses. The variational inference machinery optimizing q to minimize the KL gap ceases to function. Present-tense operational necessity.

A noise gate requires a threshold setting to operate — signals above the threshold pass through, below it get attenuated. Remove the threshold mechanism and the noise gate cannot function: it has no decision point for gating. The threshold is its constitutive control parameter.

Sample-rate is a parameter that only has meaning within the sampling framework. Remove sampling as a concept and sample-rate ceases to operate as any coherent specification — there is nothing to rate.

Prior distribution is a probability distribution over the parameter space Θ of a statistical model. Remove the statistical model and the parameter space vanishes — the prior has no domain to be defined over. The concept ceases to operate as a distribution over parameters.

The flanger technique operates through signal processing: a short delay line modulated by an LFO, producing comb filtering through constructive/destructive interference. Its persistence mechanism is DSP code and algorithmic recipe. Remove signal processing as the theoretical and practical framework, and the flanger has no operational mechanism — the comb filter mathematics, delay line architecture, and LFO modulation are all signal processing concepts. Direction: flanger→signal-processing.

The exponential-family is a class of probability distributions. Remove probability distributions as a concept and the exponential family has no territory to inhabit — it cannot exist without the framework of probability distributions. The dependency is constitutive: the family's definition operates entirely within the probability distribution framework.
For whose sake: modulation (chorus, flanger, phaser, vibrato) is designed and maintained for audio-engineering, enriching timbre and adding motion to sounds in mixing and production. Servant→master.

Nudges are built for the sake of policy — behavioral interventions designed to influence outcomes without coercion. Law 8d: for whose sake? The nudge is the servant; policy is the master. Direction: servant→master.

Sample-and-hold captures instantaneous value of continuous-time signal and maintains it. Remove signal and capture mechanism has nothing to sample, hold duration has no value to retain. Removal test passes.

Speaker is a specific kind of transducer: it converts electrical audio signals into acoustic sound waves via electro-acoustic transduction. The accepted definition of transducer covers electro-acoustic energy conversion; a competent speaker would call a speaker a transducer.

Digital reverbs and many algorithmic reverbs build their dense reflection tail by feeding a network of delay-lines with feedback. Remove delay-lines and the core echo-density mechanism of the Schroeder/FDN families stops operating — the reverb cannot produce the timed reflections that define its sound. The dependency is constitutive for the algorithmic class.

HNR is computed per frame from a short-time spectrum; the harmonic and noise energies are derived from the STFT magnitude. Remove STFT and the frame-wise spectral estimates needed for HNR disappear and the metric stops operating.

Differential entropy is defined via the continuous probability density function; remove probability distributions and the integral defining differential entropy ceases to operate, satisfying Law 8 removal test.

A desk clamp holds objects to a desk via screw-driven pressure that creates friction. Remove friction and the clamp slips — it ceases to operate. This is a constitutive present-tense dependency, not merely historical.
Phase vocoder was developed as a specific application/derivative of STFT-based analysis-synthesis, building directly on STFT frames.

A compressor needs a threshold level to operate: the threshold defines the amplitude point at which compression begins. Remove the threshold and the compressor cannot determine when to compress — its core function ceases.

An amplifier requires external power to modulate the output signal. Remove power and the amplifier cannot operate — its core mechanism (using external power to amplify an input signal) collapses. Present-tense operational dependency per Law 8.

The spectral flanger operates via FFT-based phase manipulation across frequency bins. Remove the fourier-transform and the spectral flanger cannot compute the frequency-domain decomposition needed for its mechanism. The removal test passes. Direction: spectral-flanger→fourier-transform.

A ring modulator multiplies two audio signals, producing sum and difference frequencies — this IS frequency modulation at audio rate. Remove the FM mechanism and the ring modulator produces nothing but silent multiplication. Constitutive dependency.

CONTAINS = part-of, pinned to the target's own accepted definition: information retrieval 'comprises: (1) a document corpus, (2) an index...' — the search index is a constitutive component of the IR system, not merely related to it. Pinned sense: the computational/search-index sense of 'index' (its accepted definition traces marginal notation to algorithmic retrieval), the sense in which the index is a part of IR — not the book-index sense standing alone. Direction: whole (IR) contains part (index).
A crossover splits audio signals into frequency bands and requires a signal path (signal-chain) to operate. Remove the signal-chain and the crossover cannot route signals to its outputs.

Socks are knitted garments built and maintained for the sake of clothing practice: they cover the foot and lower leg to provide warmth, comfort, and hygiene within the broader clothing system. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

An anthology is a collection of literary works compiled for the sake of literature — its designed purpose is to present, preserve, and showcase literary works in collected form. SERVES direction: the collection (servant) points at the domain it serves (literature).

Nearest kind, completing the ladder I just ruled on. The accepted harmonic-exciter definition carves: adds upper harmonics to a source signal, parameters drive/excitation amount and dry/processed blend ratio. The accepted saturator definition carves: drives a modeled or real nonlinear circuit (tube, transformer, tape, transistor) into mild saturation, adding even- and odd-order harmonics to enrich timbre. These are the same mechanism family — an exciter is a saturator whose drive stage is filtered and blended rather than inserted in-line; the difference is blend/filter parameters, not kind. A competent speaker calls an exciter 'a saturator' (the gear world sells the two interchangeably). Nearest-kind check: no accepted rung between exciter and distortion other than saturator itself; saturator INSTANCE_OF distortion is already accepted, so distortion is inherited up the ladder (Law 11e). Pinned sense: kind-of, per the target's accepted device definition (Law 11d).

Spectral gating is a specific kind of audio effect in the pinned sense: the accepted carve of audio-effect is 'a signal processing technique or device that intentionally alters a sound signal to change its perceptual character, creating a version distinguishable from the unprocessed source.' Spectral gating intentionally alters a sound signal (per-band threshold attenuation) and the processed version is plainly distinguishable from the source. Precedent in the accepted record: noise-gate INSTANCE_OF audio-effect (a time-domain gate) is accepted; spectral gating is the same gate kind operating per-band in the frequency domain. Nearest-kind test (Law 11e): the direct parent for a named effect is audio-effect; its noise-reduction role is already carried by the separate accepted edge spectral-gating INSTANCE_OF noise-reduction, so this edge is not a derivable leap but the effect-kind rung. Filed from the canonical node; the duplicate spectral-gate node's parallel edge was struck as a duplicate.

phase-retrieval IS a DSP technique that reconstructs phase from magnitude spectrograms -- its entire methodology is built on signal-processing fundamentals (STFT, spectral analysis, frequency-domain operations). Remove signal-processing and phase retrieval stops operating.

Mask-based enhancement (spectral masking for speech separation) operates by processing the signal's spectral representation — remove signal-processing as a discipline and mask-based enhancement has no framework, algorithms, or mathematical basis to operate within.
Phase retrieval algorithms operate on magnitude spectrograms produced by STFT; without STFT analysis there is no input representation for retrieval.
For whose sake: delay is designed and maintained for audio-engineering, creating echoes, spatial depth, and rhythmic effects in mixing and sound-design workflows. Servant→master.

Gossip is a social mechanism built for the sake of information spread — its designed purpose is to circulate information (news, judgments, observations) through informal channels. It serves the operation of information flow. Servant→master.

Negativity bias — the tendency to give greater weight to negative experiences — is a specific type of heuristic or systematic cognitive tendency. Under Law 7, which-came-first: the general concept of heuristic (mental shortcut, cognitive tendency) predates the specific naming of negativity bias (Baumeister et al. 2001). The negativity bias is derived from the broader heuristic/cognitive-tendency concept.

Headphone-amplifier is built to increase voltage to drive headphones; its output stage, voltage swing, and impedance are designed for the headphone load. Servant points at master per Law 8d: the amplifier exists for the headphones' sake.

Stereo is a specific configuration of two channels for left/right reproduction; audio-routing is the general class of channel mapping and signal path arrangements. Stereo is a kind of audio-routing, not a routing technology in general.

distortion is a specific kind of audio-effect: it intentionally alters sound by clipping or overdriving an electronic signal to add harmonic content. As an audio-effect, it is a tool for deliberate sound modification through signal processing — the core purpose of any audio-effect.

A saturator IS a specific kind of saturation: it is an electronic/hardware device or plugin that produces saturation (soft clipping and harmonic enrichment). A competent speaker would call a saturator 'a form of saturation.' Nearest kind on this classification path.

Law 9 specific-to-general, nearest kind: DAC's accepted carve is 'an electronic circuit or integrated chip that reconstructs a continuous analog voltage waveform from a stream of discrete digital codes' — input form: discrete digital codes, output form: continuous analog voltage, transformation law: quantization ladder plus reconstruction filter. That is precisely converter's carve (domain transformation preserving information content). No more specific kind node exists, so converter is the nearest accepted kind.

An LFO produces periodic oscillation — its entire operational mechanism is generating oscillation at sub-audio frequencies. Remove oscillation and the LFO concept ceases to operate: there would be no oscillation to produce. Law 8 removal test passes.

Vibrato is an audio effect that produces periodic pitch variation through frequency modulation. The modulation signal is generated by an oscillator. Remove the oscillator — no modulating signal is produced — and the vibrato mechanism stops operating. The oscillator is constitutive to vibrato's operation as a frequency-modulation effect.

Frequency modulation is a member of the modulation family whose varied carrier property is frequency: modulation's accepted definition carves "varying one or more properties of a carrier signal (amplitude, frequency, or phase)," and FM is exactly the frequency case, with its parameters (deviation, modulation index) as the family's parameters specialized to frequency. A competent speaker calls FM "a kind of modulation," so the specific points at the general (Law 9). Pinned sense is the family sense the target's own definition carves (Law 11d); nearest kind is modulation itself — the accepted sibling rung AM→modulation shows no intermediate rung exists (Law 11e). Direction tested: FM is the specific, modulation the general.

Headroom measures the gap between nominal level and the point where clipping occurs. Remove clipping (signal distortion at maximum amplitude) and headroom ceases to have meaning — it has no boundary to measure against. The concept of headroom is constitutively tied to clipping as its limit point.

STFT IS the core signal-processing operation that decomposes a signal into time-frequency components. It is a constitutive DSP technique -- the mechanism by which phase-retrieval and spectral-subtraction operate.
Formalism is a specific approach to foundational study that is a type of logical methodology — it treats mathematical systems as formal symbolic manipulations governed by rules.

Microphones are a specific kind of transducer: they convert acoustic sound waves into electrical audio signals via electro-acoustic transduction. The accepted definition of transducer covers this mechanism. A competent speaker would call a microphone a transducer.

Posterior distribution p(θ|x) is computed via Bayes rule as the product of likelihood p(x|θ) and prior p(θ). Remove the likelihood function and the posterior has no data-feeding term — Bayes rule cannot operate. This is an operational dependency, not merely conceptual association.

A notary public is a legal official built to serve law — their function is to authenticate signatures and prevent fraud in legal documents, which directly serves the legal system's need for verified documentation. The notary exists by design to further the operation of law.

Abstraction ladder is a specific kind of framework: a structured way of organizing levels of abstraction or generality. Nearest kind: framework. A competent speaker would call an abstraction ladder 'a framework' for thinking about levels of detail.

Flanger mixes the input signal with a slightly delayed copy (0.1-20ms), where the delay time is continuously swept by an LFO to create the characteristic whoosh. Remove delay — both signals are identical and in phase — and the interference pattern disappears. The delay element is the core mechanism of flanging.

Tape saturation operates on signals: the accepted definition states 'the signal passes through a non-linear transfer curve that adds even-order harmonics and progressively compresses peaks.' Remove signal and tape saturation has no material to process — it ceases to function. Removal test passes: without a signal input, the technique has nothing to saturate. Present-tense operational dependency per Law 8b, same physical interpretation as accepted speaker→signal, preamp→signal, reverb→signal, equalization→signal.

Vibrato is pitch variation produced by low-frequency modulation of oscillator frequency. Remove modulation and vibrato has no mechanism — it operates by applying a modulating signal to vary pitch cyclically.

A preamp (preamplifier) is a device whose sole function is amplification of weak input signals (e.g., from a microphone or guitar pickup) to a level suitable for further processing. Remove amplification and the preamp has no operation — it is not merely related to amplification, it IS amplification. The removal test passes: without the concept/technology of amplification, a preamp cannot exist or operate.

Sample-rate IS a measurement: it quantifies the frequency of sampling events (samples per second). A competent speaker classifies sample-rate as 'a kind of measurement' — specifically a temporal frequency measurement in digital audio. Nearest kind per Law 9.

A noise floor IS a specific kind of noise: the baseline level of background noise in a system. A competent speaker calls a noise floor 'a noise' — specifically, the quietest noise present. Nearest kind.

The chi-squared statistic was designed by Pearson specifically for the purpose of testing goodness-of-fit — measuring how well observed frequencies match expected frequencies under a null model. The test statistic SERVES the goodness-of-fit evaluation: remove goodness-of-fit as a goal and the chi-squared statistic loses its primary designed purpose. Servant (chi-squared-statistic) points at master (goodness-of-fit).

Spatialization IS a specific kind of audio-processing: it creates the perception of sound direction, distance, and spatial location through signal processing techniques (HRTF, ambisonics, spatial panning). The audio-processing accepted definition explicitly lists spatialization as a processing type. Pinned sense: spatialization as an audio processing technique. Nearest kind per Law 9.

DEPENDS_ON removal test: tape saturation operates by nonlinearly compressing and clipping an audio signal to produce warm harmonic distortion. Remove distortion and tape saturation has no mechanism — it becomes a linear preamp with no tonal character. Its core operation is distortion-based.

KL-divergence D_KL(P||Q) = -sum P(x)log Q(x) + sum P(x)log P(x) = cross-entropy(P,Q) - entropy(P). KL is literally decomposed into cross-entropy minus entropy terms. Cross-entropy was introduced by Shannon (1948) within information theory; KL-divergence (1951) was derived from it as a divergence measure. Cross-entropy is the more fundamental construct.

Collation is a specific process of collecting, arranging, and comparing material (especially documents or data). The nearest kind is 'process' — collation IS a process, just a specific kind involving gathering and organizing. Sense: the procedural activity of assembling and arranging.

Speech processing (analysis, synthesis, enhancement) is built and maintained for the sake of improving how well speech can be understood — speech intelligibility is its designed purpose. Servant (speech-processing) points at master (speech-intelligibility) per Law 8d.

begging-the-question (circular reasoning fallacy) operates by assuming the conclusion within its premises. Remove assumption from the mechanism and the fallacy cannot function — it literally needs an unstated premise to take effect. Law 8: present-tense operating dependency.

Retroduction (inference to the best explanation) requires logic to evaluate competing hypotheses and determine which explanation best accounts for the evidence. Remove logic and retroduction loses its criteria for valid inference — the process of weighing explanatory power, consistency, and predictive adequacy all depend on logical evaluation.

Removal test (Law 8b): Fisher information J(θ) = E_{p_θ}[(∂/∂θ log p_θ(X))²] is defined as an expectation taken under the model density p_θ. Remove the probability-distribution concept and there is no density to differentiate and no measure to integrate over — the statistic has no object to operate on and stops operating entirely, not merely stopping being sayable. Matches the board's accepted pattern for measures defined on distributions (statistical-divergence, differential-entropy DEPENDS_ON probability-distribution).

Stereo is a human-made sound reproduction technique built and maintained for the sake of audio engineering practice: it provides spatial soundstage creation for recording, mixing, mastering, and playback, with parameters for channel count and binaural rendering. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

A clipper is a device/circuit that performs clipping — it truncates signal peaks that exceed a threshold. Remove clipping and the clipper has no operation. The removal test is clear: without the technique of clipping, a clipper is inert. This is not merely a purpose claim; it is a genuine dependency on the operating principle.
Chorus adds character by modulating the delay time with a low-frequency oscillator. Remove modulation and chorus loses its time-varying character — it becomes a simple delay, not a chorus effect.

amplitude IS a specific kind of measurement: it quantifies the magnitude or strength of a signal — voltage, pressure, displacement, etc. A competent speaker in physics or audio engineering would call amplitude a type of measurement. Ladder: measurement is the nearest general kind.

Audio monitoring is a specific practice within audio engineering: the discipline of listening to and assessing sound during production. A competent speaker classifies monitoring as a kind of audio engineering. Nearest kind is audio-engineering per Law 11e.

A noise gate compares incoming signal level against a threshold to decide when to open or close the gate. Remove the threshold concept and the noise-gate mechanism has no operational reference — it cannot determine when to attenuate. Constitutive dependency confirmed.

Mid-side processing IS a specific kind of signal processing: it encodes, processes, and decodes audio signals using mid/side channel transforms. Competent speakers would call it 'a signal-processing technique'.

Sample-clock is a timing reference built for the sake of audio engineering: it synchronizes A/D and D/A conversion and digital devices to a common sampling rate, enabling coherent recording and playback. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

Prior distribution is the essential input to Bayes rule: p(th|x) ~ p(x|th)*p(th). Remove the prior and the Bayesian update mechanism has no multiplicative input -- posterior cannot be computed. Law 8b removal test satisfied.
audio engineering practice removes signal and stops operating; engineering is about manipulating signal.

DEPENDS_ON removal test: an overdrive effect produces its signature warm saturation through soft-clipping distortion. Remove distortion entirely and the overdrive mechanism vanishes — it becomes just a gain stage with no tonal character. Overdrive depends on distortion to operate.
An arraignment is a specific legal procedure within the law system. Clean specific→general INSTANCE_OF (Law 9).

A comparator DEPENDS_ON signal: the removal test passes — remove the concept of a signal (an entity carrying information or energy through a medium), and a comparator ceases to operate because it has nothing to compare. Its entire function is to process an input signal against a threshold; without signal there is no operational target.

AIC was derived from information-theoretic considerations: Akaike showed that minimizing the estimated Kullback–Leibler divergence between the true model and a candidate model leads to the AIC formula. Information theory (Shannon, 1948; extended to KL divergence by Kullback and Leibler, 1951) existed before AIC (1974) and directly fed into its derivation. Historical direction: information theory came first and fed into AIC.

Bit-crusher is an audio effect technique built for the sake of audio engineering: it reduces bit depth and sample rate to produce lo-fi texture, used in mixing and sound design. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

A de-esser requires band-pass filtering to isolate sibilant frequencies (typically 4-10 kHz) before applying gain reduction. Remove the band-pass filter and the de-esser cannot selectively target sibilance — it becomes a generic compressor. The filtering is a necessary operational component.

AIC is a specific member of the information-criterion family: its formula 2k − 2·logL is one fit-vs-complexity scoring rule of the family, distinguished by its penalty function (2k per free parameter). Law 9 specific→general: a competent speaker calls AIC 'an information criterion'. Nearest kind (Law 11e): the family itself — no intermediate rung exists, so the leap is the first true connection.

Law 8d 'for whose sake?': Fisher information was constructed (R. A. Fisher, 1925) to quantify how accurately a parameter can be estimated — it is the load-bearing quantity of the Cramér-Rao bound (the variance floor 1/I(θ) for unbiased estimators) and the measure of estimator efficiency.
