Its purpose, named in its own definition, is the evaluation and design of statistical estimation; the servant points at estimation. Matches the accepted SERVES precedent of statistical-estimator and sufficient-statistic toward estimation.

Removal test: remove burden of proof and presumption of innocence — the legal principle that the accused is innocent until proven guilty — loses its operational meaning. These are two sides of one mechanism: the burden-of-proof assigns the obligation to the prosecution, and the presumption-of-innocence shifts the default state. Remove the burden concept and there's nothing to bear; the presumption collapses. They co-define the same legal architecture.

A reverb unit requires a delay-line (or equivalent memory buffer) to operate. Remove the delay mechanism — no stored echoes, no reverb tail. The delay-line is constitutive: the persistence mechanism for the reverberation effect.

Pinned sense: stereo as a spatial audio technique that creates directional perception of sound using two or more channels. Stereo IS a specific kind of spatialization: the spatialization definition explicitly lists binaural (HRTF-based) as a spatial model, and stereo exploits binaural hearing via left-right channel separation to produce spatial perception. Nearest kind per Law 9 and 11d.

A gloss is a specific type of annotation (brief explanation of a word/term). Remove annotation as a concept and gloss has no functional category — it is an annotation practice. The gloss operates on text as an annotated layer. The removal test passes: no annotation concept = no gloss operation.

collation is a technique built and maintained for the sake of bibliography. In textual criticism and book history, collation (examining manuscript copies to determine their relationship) serves the broader practice of bibliographic analysis. The servant (collation) points at the master (bibliography).

Natural gradient is an optimization algorithm that uses the Fisher information metric to precondition gradients. It is built and maintained for the sake of optimization — specifically for more efficient optimization in curved parameter spaces. Law 8d: servant (natural gradient) points at master (optimization).

A minimum-phase filter is designed to minimize phase distortion in signal processing pipelines. It is built and maintained for the sake of signal processing practice — specifically, for applications where preserving causal phase relationships is essential (audio, communications, control systems).

A comparator DEPENDS_ON threshold: the removal test passes — remove the concept of a threshold (a defined crossing point between states), and a comparator ceases to operate because its entire function is to compare a signal against a threshold level. Without a threshold, there is nothing for the comparator to compare against; the device has no operational purpose.

Socks are knitted garments made for the sake of foot comfort, warmth, and hygiene; they are produced and maintained as accessories for clothing systems, not as independent tools. Servant points to beneficiary per Law 8d.

A formant vocoder is a speech synthesis technique whose purpose is to enhance speech quality and intelligibility — it is built for the sake of speech enhancement. SERVES tested: formant-vocoder → speech-enhancement (servant→master). Direction: formant-vocoder exists to serve speech-enhancement.

A proviso is a conditional clause within a contract — its entire operation and meaning depend on being part of a contract. Remove contract and a proviso ceases to function as a legal instrument (it has no independent existence). The removal test passes. Direction: proviso→contract.

scientific-method DEPENDS_ON retroduction: the scientific method relies on retroduction (abduction/inference to the best explanation) for generating hypotheses and explanatory models from observations. Remove retroduction and the scientific method loses its primary hypothesis-formation mechanism — it can deduce and induce, but cannot abductively generate novel explanatory constructs. This is constitutive to scientific reasoning.

Begging the question operates by having the conclusion assumed in the premises. The fallacy's mechanism is the operation of an assumption masquerading as support. Remove the concept of assumption and this fallacy cannot operate — it is structurally constituted by assumption, not merely associated with it.

Iconography is a specific type of symbolic system — a collection of visual symbols with conventional meanings in a particular context. The nearest general kind is symbolic-system (a system of symbols and their interpretive rules). Direction: iconography (specific) → symbolic-system (general).

Chorus duplicates the input signal, adds a short delay (15-50ms) to the copy, and modulates that delay time with an LFO. Remove delay — the copy and original are identical and in phase — and the thickened, multiplied sound vanishes. Delay is structurally necessary: without it the effect collapses to the dry signal.

User feedback requires communication to operate — it is expressed through language, surveys, interviews, or other communicative channels. Remove communication and user feedback cannot be expressed, collected, or transmitted. The mechanism of user feedback IS communication.

Removal test: beyond-reasonable-doubt's accepted carve makes it a criminal-law standard of proof whose parameters are prosecution, the elements of the charged offense, and a fact-finder — all offices of the legal framework. Remove law (the enforceable rule framework with jurisdiction) and there is no prosecution, no charged offense, no fact-finder; the threshold has nothing to operate on and ceases to function. Pinned sense: BRD as a normative threshold operating inside legal adjudication, per its accepted definition. Nearest-kind precedent already accepted in the cluster: presumption-of-innocence DEPENDS_ON law and burden-of-proof DEPENDS_ON law. (standard-of-proof by contrast carves non-legal domains — science, ordinary reasoning — and correctly carries no such edge.)

Hindsight-bias operates by distorting what is remembered of prior beliefs. Remove recall — the capacity to retrieve what one previously thought — and the mechanism collapses: you cannot misremember what you cannot remember. Pinned sense: recall as the retrieval mechanism of prior mental states.

dynamic-range-processing is a specific practice within audio engineering: compressors, expanders, limiters, gates are standard audio engineering tools for controlling dynamics. Competent speaker test passes: dynamic-range-processing is a kind of audio engineering. Nearest kind is audio-engineering, not broader engineering.

The Butterworth filter is a signal filter specifically designed for signal processing applications — its purpose is to provide a maximally flat frequency response in the passband for signal processing tasks. Servant (butterworth-filter) points at master (signal-processing).

Demodulation is a technique built for the sake of recovering information from modulated carriers within signal processing practice. Remove demodulation and receivers cannot recover the original signal from its modulation — the processing stops operating.
MCD computation requires MFCC vectors as input; remove MFCC computation and MCD cannot operate — removal test satisfied, Law 8. Dependency is object-level, not meta-level.

Log-sum-exp is a numerical trick that computes the log of a sum of exponentials in a numerically stable way. It is built for the sake of optimization, where it enables stable computation of softmax, partition functions, and log-likelihoods that would otherwise overflow or underflow.

An apograph is a specific type of document: a copy made from an original manuscript. 'Is an apograph a type of document?' Yes — it is a document that reproduces the content of an earlier manuscript copy. The nearest kind is document.

A conjecture is a proposed proposition offered to advance reasoning. It is built and maintained for the sake of inference — providing candidate claims to test, explore, and ultimately prove or disprove. Designed purpose: servant (conjecture) → master (inference). Law 8d satisfied.

Conceptual metaphor is a theory of how humans understand one concept in terms of another (e.g. ARGUMENT IS WAR). Under Law 9, it is a specific kind of cognitive bias — a systematic pattern in how thought is structured. The nearest accepted kind is cognitive bias.
Variational inference IS a specific kind of Bayesian inference: it approximates Bayesian posteriors via optimization. Specific→general.

Cepstral peak prominence is a metric built and maintained for the sake of audio processing practice: it measures the salience of the cepstral peak for voice quality assessment, detecting periodicity and vocal effort in speech analysis toolchains. Servant→master per Law 8d.
Mask-based enhancement is a specific class of speech enhancement algorithms that use time-frequency masks. Specific→general INSTANCE_OF per Law 9.

A limiter is a compressor with an extremely high ratio that prevents signals from exceeding a threshold. Remove compression and the limiter has no mechanism — it operates as a specialized compressor with infinite threshold clamp.

Sample rate is the rate at which a signal is sampled. The concept of sample rate only operates in the context of a signal being sampled. Remove the signal — the thing being sampled — and sample rate ceases to have operational meaning. Per Law 8 removal test.

State-space models represent systems through differential equations and state variables, serving signal processing by enabling optimal filtering (Kalman filter), prediction, and system identification. They serve the field by providing a mathematical framework for modeling and processing dynamic signals.

A sample rate is a specific kind of frequency: the number of times per second a signal is sampled. The note pins the sense: frequency is the number of occurrences of a repeating event per unit time, and sample rate is that quantity applied to discrete sampling. Law 9: specific→general, nearest kind. This supersedes the measurement edge as the more precise rung.

MLE is estimation in a specific, named sense: determining an unknown parameter by maximizing the likelihood of the observed data. It passes the nearest-kind test: 'estimation' is the general procedure for determining approximate values from partial information, and no accepted intermediate kind (parameter-estimation, likelihood-based method, ...) sits between. A competent practitioner says 'MLE is a method of estimation' without qualification. INSTANCE_OF against the nearest kind (Laws 9, 11e).

Ducking is a specific kind of audio effect: it intentionally alters the perceptual balance of a mix by dynamically attenuating one signal in response to another, creating a version distinguishable from unprocessed source. Competent engineers call ducking an audio effect. Nearest kind is audio-effect.

Tagging is the practice of attaching identifying labels to items. It fundamentally requires naming — a tag IS a name applied to identify something. Remove naming and tagging stops operating: there is no mechanism to create identifying labels. The removal test passes constitutively.

A notion is a discrete conceptual unit — a mental category drawn to partition the space of possibilities. Remove the capacity for categorization and notions cannot form: they ARE categorized distinctions. The dependency is constitutive — categorization is the cognitive process that enables notions to exist as operational units. Direction: notion (newer, specific construct) depends on categorization (older, enabling capacity).

The Butterworth filter is a signal processing filter designed to have a frequency response as flat as possible in the passband. It depends on signal-processing — the theory, design, and application of Butterworth filters exist within the framework of signal processing.

Bias-variance decomposition is defined in terms of Var(f̂) as a component of the expected squared error. Remove variance from the mathematical vocabulary and the decomposition cannot be expressed or evaluated operationally; the formula ceases to operate. Law 8b removal test satisfied.

A formant vocoder synthesizes speech by modeling vocal tract resonances (formants) and serves speech processing by providing a parametric approach to speech analysis and synthesis. It is a tool used within speech processing pipelines for vocoder-based processing and analysis.

The Nyquist-Shannon sampling theorem is formulated and proved using Fourier transform theory — bandlimited signals are reconstructed from samples via the sinc interpolation formula, which is a direct consequence of the Fourier transform's frequency-domain properties. Remove the Fourier transform and the theorem's defining mechanism (bandlimited reconstruction) cannot operate. Constitutive dependency.

A saturator is a specific kind of distortion effect — it intentionally adds harmonic distortion (primarily even-order harmonics from gentle nonlinear operation) to enrich signal timbre. Nearest kind: distortion, per accepted definition. Not DEPENDS_ON — saturation is its operating principle, not an external dependency.

Audio-jitter is a measurement concept maintained for audio-processing practice: engineers monitor jitter to diagnose timing errors, design clocking and buffering strategies, and evaluate streaming quality. The concept is built for the sake of reliable audio processing; servant points to beneficiary per Law 8d.

Phase retrieval reconstructs phase from magnitude spectrograms to restore perceptual quality of speech signals. It is built for the purpose of serving speech enhancement, servant points at master per Law 8d.

Acoustic measurement is built and maintained for the sake of audio processing: it quantifies acoustic properties (sound pressure, frequency response, reverberation time) to inform processing decisions, verify processing results, and establish baselines for audio engineering practice. For whose sake? Audio processing uses measurement to validate and refine its operations.

Phase unwrapping is built and maintained for the sake of audio processing: it recovers continuous phase from wrapped measurements, enabling phase vocoder and other time-frequency operations. Servant points at master.

Formalism is a specific kind of philosophy — specifically a philosophy of mathematics. It holds that mathematics is a game of symbol manipulation governed by formal rules, independent of meaning or interpretation. A competent speaker would say 'formalism is a philosophy (of mathematics).' The nearest kind is philosophy, not logic (which would be a domain error per Law 9a).

Posterior distribution is computed via Bayes rule as proportional to likelihood times prior. Removing the prior removes the multiplicative factor; the posterior cannot be computed or operated as Bayesian update. Operational cessation.
Audio compression is a specific audio effect that reduces dynamic range. Specific → general per Law 9.

Audio-clock-drift is a human-made measurement concept constructed to map systematic deviation of digital audio clocks from reference time. It is built and maintained for the sake of audio processing: engineers use drift rate and accumulation parameters to design compensation algorithms, synchronize sample rates, and ensure correct time alignment in processing chains. Remove audio-clock-drift as a documented practice and audio processing loses a defined target for clock synchronization and error budgeting; the concept points at audio-processing as its beneficiary. Servant→master.

de-esser IS a specific kind of compressor: it is a dynamics compressor that targets a specific frequency band (sibilant frequencies) rather than the full signal. The removal test passes — remove compressor and a de-esser (as a type of compressor) cannot exist. Nearest kind: compressor (ACCEPTED).

Remove signal — audio-clock-drift stops operating. Clock drift is defined as timing divergence between sampled signals in audio systems; without the concept of signal the phenomenon is nameless and inoperable.

Phase coherence quantifies consistency of phase relationships across frequency components or over time. Measuring consistency requires a phase response as input; without phase response data, coherence cannot be computed or assessed. Removal of phase response stops phase coherence operation.

An expander increases dynamic range by attenuating the portion of a signal BELOW a threshold level. Its own accepted definition names 'threshold level below which expansion applies' as parameter (1) — the threshold is the mechanism object on which the expander's gain-reduction is conditioned. Pinned sense of 'threshold': a defined point of crossing mediating two states (here, the level regions below/above the threshold). Removal test (Laws 2b/8b): remove the threshold and the expander has no reference level deciding WHICH portion to attenuate; it stops operating. Not identity (an expander is not a threshold) and not purpose. Mechanism-object dependency, same family as the accepted limiting→threshold.

Send effect is a specific kind of audio effect: it is an effect routing configuration that processes audio via parallel split and mix, altering signal character. A competent engineer classifies send effect as a form of audio effect. Nearest kind per Law 11e is audio-effect.

Noise cancellation requires a transducer to operate: the technique works by having a transducer (speaker driver) emit anti-phase sound waves that destructively interfere with ambient noise. Remove the transducer, and noise cancellation cannot function at all — there is no mechanism to generate the cancelling waveform. This is a present-tense operating dependency, not a historical or sayable relationship.

Audio-routing IS a specific kind of audio-processing: it manipulates and redirects audio signals as part of the broader processing workflow. A competent speaker classifies routing as 'a kind of audio processing.' Nearest kind per Law 9.

Audio-clock-drift is a measurement concept maintained for audio-processing practice: engineers monitor drift to keep sample rates aligned across devices, compensate in playback/recording chains, and design clocking hardware. The concept is built for the sake of reliable audio processing; servant points to beneficiary per Law 8d.

Audio monitoring is a specific kind of monitoring focused on listening to and evaluating audio signals. The note pins the sense: monitoring is the systematic observation and checking of a process or system, and audio monitoring is that practice applied to audio. Law 9: specific→general, nearest kind.

Bayes factor is a statistic used to compare the evidence for two competing hypotheses. It is built and maintained for the sake of hypothesis testing — its entire purpose is to quantify relative evidence between H1 and H2. Law 8d: the servant (bayes-factor) points at the master (hypothesis-testing).

Law 7 which-came-first test: the delay-line flanger (dry + short LFO-modulated time delay) is the original effect; the spectral flanger realizes the same flanging delay in the frequency domain (modulated phase ramp across STFT bins) as a later derivative implementation, and its own definition names the classic delay-line flanger as the thing it is distinct from. Newer derives from older; direction spectral-flanger -> flanger.

A subwoofer depends on a crossover to operate as intended. The crossover separates low frequencies (handled by the sub) from mid/high frequencies (handled by main speakers). Remove the crossover and the subwoofer reproduces its full range, bleeding into frequencies main speakers cannot handle cleanly — the system fails to operate as a proper subwoofer configuration. The removal test passes: no crossover, no proper subwoofer function.

Sample-and-hold is a specific technique for capturing and holding the instantaneous value of a continuous-time signal. It is a particular kind of sampling operation — a method of sampling that includes both the capture (sample) and the retention (hold) phases. Nearest kind: sampling.

Compressor is a dynamic range compression device built and maintained for the sake of audio processing: it attenuates signal peaks above a threshold according to configurable ratio, attack, and release parameters, enabling level control and tonal shaping in audio production. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

a corollary is a proposition that follows directly from one already proven. Remove logic and the concept of logical consequence ceases to exist — corollaries have no operation without the framework of logical derivation. Present-tense dependency.
A provider-turn is a specific kind of communication protocol: the turn-taking protocol governing how users and AI provider systems exchange requests and responses in a chat or completion endpoint.

Input validation checks and sanitizes external data before processing. It is built and maintained for the sake of robustness — preventing malformed, adversarial, or unexpected input from causing crashes, corruption, or security vulnerabilities.

A comb-filter IS a specific kind of signal processing technique — it produces a comb-shaped frequency response through delayed superposition. A competent speaker would call a comb-filter 'a signal processing method.' Per Law 9: specific→general maps to INSTANCE_OF.

Overdrive is a specific kind of distortion — soft-clipping that adds warm even-order harmonics. A competent speaker calls overdrive 'a type of distortion' (Law 9). Pinned sense: overdrive as the gentle, tube-amplifier-style clipping effect, as opposed to hard clipping (distortion) or full-wave rectification (fuzz).

Law 7 which-came-first: Wiener (1949) is the frequency-domain minimum-mean-squared-error solution; Kalman (1960) is the recursive time-domain generalization of the same optimal-estimation problem, and the wiener-filter's own accepted definition closes by naming it 'the limit that Kalman filtering generalizes in the time domain.' Y existed first and fed into X. DERIVED_FROM, not DEPENDS_ON: the Kalman filter still operates without any Wiener filter present.

Jurisdiction is a legal construct that requires language to define its boundaries, express its rules, and enforce its scope. Remove language and jurisdiction cannot operate — legal boundaries become unexpressed, jurisdictional authority cannot be articulated. This is object-level: jurisdiction's mechanism IS linguistic articulation of authority domains, not merely needing language to be discussed.

A headphone stand is a specific kind of rack designed to hold headphones. The note pins the sense: a rack is a framework or structure for holding things, and a headphone stand is that structure adapted for headphone storage. Law 9: specific→general, nearest kind.

Stereo is a specific human-made technique for sound reproduction using two or more independent channels to create spatial perception. It is a particular operation within the human-made map of audio-processing: the audio-processing definition lists spatialization, channel-based encoding, and reproduction as processing types. Stereo is a specific kind of audio-processing, not a general class, and not derivable via an intermediate accepted rung. Nearest kind per Law 9 and Law 11e.

Minimum-phase filters are defined by the Hilbert transform relationship between log-magnitude and phase in the frequency domain — a relationship computed via the Fourier transform. Remove the Fourier transform and the filter's defining property (minimum phase = phase uniquely determined by magnitude) cannot be computed or expressed. The Fourier transform is a constitutive operating requirement.
Speech enhancement is a specific signal-processing discipline for improving speech quality. Specific→general.

Remove the screw — a fastener whose driven head (slotted, Phillips, Torx) a tip geometry matches — and the screwdriver stops operating: its shaft and tip have nothing to rotate, and its identity as a turning implement collapses into a stick. Not identity (Law 8c): a screwdriver is a tool, a screw is a fastener (separate categories; screw is INSTANCE_OF fastener). The screw is the functional object the screwdriver requires — same pattern as screwdriver->leverage, where the principle required was upheld.

A compressor controls the gain of an audio signal — it adjusts amplification based on signal level relative to a threshold. Remove amplification (signal gain adjustment) and the compressor has no mechanism to operate. The core operation IS controlled amplification.
Headphone stand is built to hold headphones when not in use, preserving them and keeping workspace clear for audio engineers

Tape delay is a specific kind of delay effect: it intentionally alters sound by returning discrete repeats, using a magnetic tape loop as the delay line. A competent speaker calls tape delay 'a type of delay'.

Clipping requires saturation to operate: clipping is the truncation that occurs when a system reaches its amplitude ceiling (saturation). Remove saturation — the state of maximum capacity — and clipping has no limiting mechanism to operate against.

Cross-entropy H(p,q) = -Σ p(x) log q(x) is the extension of Shannon entropy H(p) = -Σ p(x) log p(x) to two distributions. The entropy concept (Shannon 1948) existed first and cross-entropy was derived from it — the cross-entropy formula is literally the negative expected log of q, while entropy is the same form with p=q. Entropy is the more fundamental construct that cross-entropy derives from.

Waveshaping is a specific kind of audio effect: it intentionally alters a sound signal by applying a nonlinear amplitude transfer function, producing harmonic generation and timbral shaping. A competent audio engineer calls waveshaping 'an audio effect'. Nearest kind per Law 11e is audio-effect.

Stereo is a specific audio reproduction technique that creates spatial perception using two independent channels; it is a concrete instance of audio-processing as a class of signal manipulation and reproduction methods.

Remove psychoacoustics (the understanding of human sound localization) — does spatialization stop operating? Yes: HRTF, ambisonic, and object-based spatialization all depend on psychoacoustic models. Without that understanding, these techniques have no operational basis.

Spectral flatness measure quantifies tonality vs noisiness per frame and is built for the sake of guiding noise suppression and quality assessment in speech enhancement pipelines; it is used as a feature to decide enhancement strength and to evaluate enhancement outcomes. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

Mask-based enhancement applies spectral or temporal masks to noisy signal representations to improve signal quality. It depends on signal-processing — without signal processing techniques for representation, masking, and reconstruction, mask-based enhancement has no operational framework.
Harmonic exciter is a specific kind of audio processing effect designed to add harmonic content to a signal.
Predictive distribution is the canonical Bayesian forecasting tool. Remove Bayesian inference framework and predictive distribution has no operational definition. Law 8b removal test satisfied.

A hand tool IS a specific kind of tool: a tool whose prime mover is the human hand. Direction tested: every hand tool is a tool, not every tool is hand-operated (power tools, machines are not). The kind is carved by mode of operation — hand as prime mover — not by task or substrate. Law 9: specific (hand-tool) → general (tool).

Law 8d for whose sake: headphone-amplifier is designed and maintained to boost signals to drive headphones to adequate volume and dynamic range. Removal of headphones eliminates its designed purpose; the amplifier still exists but ceases operating as a headphone-amplifier. Servant points at master.

KL-divergence is a specific f-divergence with generating function f(t) = t log(t). A competent speaker would call KL-divergence an f-divergence. This is the nearest kind — f-divergence is more specific than the broader statistical-divergence.

Partial dependence plot is a visualization technique built and maintained specifically for the sake of interpreting machine learning models, showing marginal effects of features on predictions. It is a servant tool whose designed purpose is to further machine learning interpretability.

A value proposition is a marketing construct: a clear statement of the benefits a product delivers to a specific customer segment, designed to differentiate it from competitors. Its entire purpose is to serve marketing strategy — positioning, messaging, and go-to-market. The concept does not exist outside the marketing practice. SERVES direction: value-proposition (servant) points at marketing (master).

Law 7: the practice came first. Signal-sampling (measuring amplitude at uniform instants) is the pre-existing telephony/PCM practice. The sample-rate is the standardized parameter abstracted from it: a nominal lattice (8k-384k) fixed by AES/IEC, embedded in S/PDIF, AES3, USB Audio. The accepted sampling definition already names 'the sampling rate (fixed by the system)' as the practice's own parameter. Precedent: nyquist-theorem DERIVED_FROM signal-sampling.

A phaser is a specific kind of audio effect: it intentionally alters a sound by mixing a signal with its phase-shifted self through all-pass filters to produce a sweeping comb-filter 'swoosh.' Nearest kind is audio-effect (Law 11e). Direction: specific (phaser) -> general (audio-effect).
Phase vocoder is a specific implementation family within the broader vocoder technique class, using phase information for time-scale modification.

A sample rate is a specific kind of measurement: the quantification of how many times per second a signal is sampled. The note pins the sense: measurement is the assignment of a quantity to a property, and sample rate is that process applied to temporal frequency. Law 9: specific→general, nearest kind.
Pitch shifting via time-domain processing requires variable delay lines to resample the signal. Remove delay-line and the core time-stretch mechanism stops operating.
For whose sake: gain-staging is maintained for audio-engineering, optimizing signal levels through the signal chain to prevent noise and clipping across recording and mixing. Servant→master.

Cepstral analysis computes cepstral coefficients via a sequence of signal processing operations (FFT, log-power spectrum, DCT). Removing signal processing capability stops the entire computation pipeline. Present-tense constitutive dependency.

Posterior probability p(theta|x) = p(x|theta)pi(theta)/p(x) requires the marginal likelihood p(x) as its normalizing denominator. Without marginal likelihood, posterior probabilities cannot be computed at all. The removal of marginal likelihood means the posterior stops operating.

EM is literally the iterative algorithm that maximizes the evidence lower bound (ELBO). Remove ELBO and EM has no optimization target — the E-step computes expected complete-data log-likelihood via ELBO decomposition, the M-step maximizes it. Present-tense: EM ceases to operate without ELBO.

sample-rate quantifies how frequently sampling events occur (samples per second). Remove sampling — the process of taking discrete measurements at intervals — and sample-rate has no operation. The concept of sample rate only exists within the operational context of sampling; it measures sampling's frequency.

Audio-clock-drift measures deviation of the clock that timestamps audio samples. Removing the audio-sample concept eliminates the sampling instants whose timing the drift quantifies; without samples to timestamp, drift cannot be observed or compensated. Removal now stops operation, satisfying Law 8b.

Signal amplification operates on an input signal to produce a scaled output signal. Remove the concept of signal and amplification has no input to scale and no output to produce — the technique ceases to operate. Law 8b removal test passes.

Remove signal: the subwoooper converts electrical audio signals to sound. Without an input signal to transduce, the device has nothing to operate on and stops functioning. Present-tense operational dependency.

Rationalization is a specific kind of defense mechanism in psychology: the ego protects itself from anxiety by substituting logical but false explanations for unacceptable impulses or behaviors. A competent speaker calls rationalization 'a defense mechanism.' Files against nearest kind.

An expander IS a specific kind of signal-processing: it dynamically increases the dynamic range of a signal by reducing gain for signals above a threshold. Competent speakers would call it a form of signal processing.

Tape saturation produces its characteristic warm, smooth harmonic enrichment through nonlinear compression (saturation) of the magnetic tape's response curve. Remove the saturation mechanism — the soft-clipping transfer function of the tape medium — and recording would produce clean amplification or abrupt hard clipping instead. The specific tonal character of tape saturation is parasitic on the saturation effect.
Audio mixing operates on audio signals: levels, panning, dynamics, EQ. Remove signal and mixing has nothing to process, levels to set, or balance to create. Removal test passes.

A french horn is a brass instrument built and maintained for the sake of music — its design, playing technique, and cultural role all serve musical performance and composition. The instrument exists by design to produce music.

A prior distribution encodes prior beliefs about model parameters and is used to serve statistical inference — specifically Bayesian statistics. A preamp (preamplifier) is a specific kind of amplification device: it amplifies weak input signals to a suitable level for further processing. Group delay is a specific signal-processing concept that measures the time delay of the envelope of a signal's spectral components as a function of frequency, defined as τg(ω) = −dφ(ω)/dω where φ is phase response. Sense pinned: group delay as the derivative-of-phase concept, not the colloquial sense of a delayed group acting.

Spectral-gate is a specific kind of noise-reduction: it attenuates frequency components below a threshold to reduce unwanted noise or isolate signal bands. A competent audio engineer would describe a spectral-gate as 'a noise reduction technique' or 'a spectral noise reducer'. Nearest kind per Law 11e is noise-reduction. Pinned sense: noise-reduction as the general class of techniques that reduce unwanted signal components.

Upward expansion operates by increasing gain for signals below a threshold level. Remove threshold concept and the expansion trigger has no operational reference — the technique cannot determine when to engage. Present-tense constitutive dependency per Law 8b.
Sample rate is measured in samples per second; the concept of 'per second' depends on a unit of time — a clock or timebase — to have any operational meaning.

Removal test (Laws 2b/8b): remove the electrical audio signal and the speaker has no energy to transduce - it stops operating as a speaker. Not identity (the speaker is a device, the signal is a transient it consumes) and not purpose. Same accepted family as crossover DEPENDS_ON signal.
Cepstral liftering operates on cepstral coefficients produced by cepstral analysis; the lifter weights are applied in the cepstral domain, so removal of the analysis leaves no coefficients to lifter.

Meta-cognition is the monitoring and regulation of one's own cognitive processes. It requires memory to operate: you must remember your own thoughts, decisions, and cognitive states in order to reflect on them. Remove memory — you cannot recall what you just thought, assessed, or decided — and meta-cognition stops operating. This passes the removal test of Law 8.

Elaborative interrogation is a learning technique built for the sake of education: it generates explanatory answers to why-questions to deepen understanding and retention. Law 8d: servant (elaborative-interrogation) → master (education). A pedagogical method designed to improve learning outcomes.
Audio-routing directs audio signals between paths. Remove the concept of signal and there is nothing to route — the system ceases to operate. Operational dependency per Law 8.

Mixer is built and maintained for the sake of audio engineering practice: it combines, balances, and routes multiple audio signals for recording, mixing, and live sound. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

A dynamic-range meter is a specific kind of measuring instrument: its purpose is to determine the magnitude of a measurable quantity — signal dynamic range, the spread between the loudest signal the chain can carry and its noise floor — by comparing the signal against a calibrated standard (the dBFS/dB reference scale) and converting the stimulus into a readable output (scale reading or digital value). It is not an INSTANCE_OF signal-processing (a method class, not a device class) and not of a meter in the rhythmic sense; the nearest kind is measuring instrument. A competent audio engineer calling a DR meter 'a kind of meter' means the instrument sense.

A flanger operates by modulating the delay time of a delay line with an LFO (low-frequency oscillator). Remove modulation and the flanger's characteristic sweeping comb-filter effect disappears — it becomes a static delay, not a flanger. Group delay is computed as the negative derivative of phase response with respect to frequency; remove phase response and group delay cannot be calculated or used operationally. Dependency is present-tense operational, not historical.

phase-locked-loop locks an oscillator to a reference signal, producing a stable output frequency. Remove signal-processing and the PLL has no purpose — it operates on and processes signals. Present-tense dependency.

Audio samples are the discrete time-domain values built and maintained for the sake of audio processing: DSP algorithms operate on sample sequences to filter, transform, and synthesize. Servant points at master.
Remove bias from the decomposition formula and the decomposition no longer operates as specified; the bias term is an operational input, not merely sayable.

Audio-effect is a specific human-made technique or device that intentionally alters a sound signal, which is a particular operation within the human-made map of audio-processing. MLE operates on the log-likelihood ℓ(θ|x) = log L(θ|x) as its optimization objective. Remove log-likelihood and MLE has no function to maximize — the procedure stops operating. MLE is fundamentally defined through log-likelihood maximization, whether for analytical solutions or gradient-based optimization.

Law 8d for-whose-sake test: a noise gate is built FOR THE SAKE OF reducing unwanted noise — its own accepted definition states the purpose: 'reducing background noise between intentional sound events.' A steward is a person who manages affairs on behalf of another party. Harmonic exciter generates harmonic content through controlled nonlinear processing — it is a specific kind of distortion effect designed to add harmonics. A competent speaker would classify a harmonic exciter as a type of distortion processor.

Signal chain is a framework built for audio engineering: describes sequence of processing stages for studio and live setups. Law 8d: servant (signal-chain) → master (audio engineering).

stereo IS a specific kind of audio-routing: it is a technique that routes audio signals to multiple independent channels (typically left and right) to create spatial perception. Formant-preserving-pitch-shift is a specific kind of pitch-shift that modifies pitch while additionally preserving the original formant structure (preventing the 'chipmunk effect'). A competent speaker would call it a pitch-shift: it shifts pitch as its primary operation, with formant preservation as a distinguishing parameter.

Contrastive divergence is an approximation algorithm for maximum likelihood estimation in energy-based models. It is built for the sake of optimization — providing a tractable optimization objective where exact gradient computation is intractable.

A notion is a discrete building block designed and maintained for the sake of reasoning — notions provide the structured mental categories that reasoning operates on. Without notions, reasoning has no conceptual units to manipulate. Law 8d: servant (notion) points at master (reasoning).

A phase-locked-loop is a specific kind of feedback-control system: it measures output phase, compares it to a reference, and adjusts a VCO via the error signal. The feedback loop (phase detector → loop filter → VCO) is a classic negative-feedback architecture. Nearest kind: feedback-control.

Audio-clock-drift measures the deviation of the sample-clock from its nominal rate. Remove the sample-clock and the concept of clock drift loses its measuring reference entirely — the removal test passes per Law 8b.

The scientific method CONTAINS falsifiability as a core criterion: a hypothesis must be falsifiable to qualify. Falsifiability is a component/part of the scientific method's structure.

phase IS a specific kind of measurement: it quantifies the angular offset between two periodic waveforms, measured in degrees or radians. A seal is a specific type of fastener that joins two parts together while also preventing the passage of fluids or gases through the joint. A competent speaker would call a mechanical seal a type of fastener.

The seal's accepted definition: 'an authentication mark applied to certify the origin, integrity, or authority of documents, objects, or boundaries,' produced as wax, embossed metal, stamped ink, or cryptographic signature. Sample-and-hold circuits are built and maintained for the sake of audio engineering practice: they capture instantaneous audio signal values for sampling, ADC front-ends, and waveform reconstruction.

A ring modulator is a specific kind of amplitude modulation: specifically, double-sideband suppressed-carrier AM. Both multiply two signals to produce sum and difference frequencies. Input validation — checking that input data conforms to expected format, range, type, or constraints before processing — is a specific kind of validation. A competent speaker would call input validation 'a type of validation.'

Gain-staging operates on signal levels — its entire definition centers on setting, measuring, and optimizing signal levels (input gain, output gain, headroom, metering reference) across a processing chain. cherry-pick is a specific technique of selectively using evidence, which is a kind of confirmation-bias. A competent speaker would call cherry-picking a type of confirmation bias. The specific→general direction is correct for INSTANCE_OF.

The cepstrum was invented by Bogert, Healy and Tukey specifically to detect periodic structures in spectra such as formant spacing. The concept of formants existed first and the cepstrum was developed as a technique for formant analysis.

Mid-side processing is a recording technique built for the sake of audio engineering: encodes stereo as mid+side for mixing and mastering control. Law 8d: servant (mid-side-processing) points at master (audio engineering).

Audio mixing depends on signal-processing — it manipulates audio signals through EQ, dynamics, panning, and effects, all of which are signal processing operations. The removal test: remove signal-processing and audio mixing has no conceptual or technical framework for operating on sound.

A statistical divergence is defined as a functional D[P||Q] mapping two probability distributions to a non-negative real number; remove probability distributions and the divergence has no inputs and ceases to operate — operational dependency per Law 8 removal test.

The alluvial diagram is a data visualization technique derived from the Sankey diagram. A treatise IS a specific kind of document: its accepted definition names it as 'a formal, systematic written discourse on a subject', which is a structured document. A competent speaker would recognize a treatise as a type of document — specifically, a formal, extended one.

Conditional entropy is maintained for the sake of pattern recognition — it quantifies remaining uncertainty in pattern classification, defines mutual information (the key metric for feature relevance in PR), and appears in decision tree learning (information gain for attribute selection). Hindsight bias — the tendency to see past events as having been predictable — is a specific cognitive tendency. Under Law 7, which-came-first: the general heuristic concept predates the specific hindsight bias. The bias is a named cognitive tendency derived from the broader heuristic concept.

A seal (wax seal stamp / signing device) is a specific kind of hand tool used to impress a design into sealing material. A competent speaker would call it 'a type of hand tool' — a small handheld implement for a specific task.

A headphone stand is designed and maintained for the sake of storage: it provides a dedicated place to rest and store headphones when not in use. The servant (headphone-stand) points at the master (storage). Law 8d.
