Remove the filter and the device would generate harmonics across the entire spectrum, losing its defining behavior of selectively enriching high-frequency content. The removal test passes: no filter = no frequency-selective harmonic generation.

Ducking is a specific kind of dynamic-range-compression: it reduces the level of one audio signal when a second signal exceeds a threshold. A competent audio engineer would call ducking a form of compression — specifically, sidechain-controlled compression. The sense pinned: ducking as a compression technique that modulates gain based on external signal presence, distinguishing it from ordinary compression which uses the same signal.

Tape-delay operates by storing audio on a moving tape loop and replaying it. The tape loop IS a delay-line - a storage-and-retrieval mechanism. Remove the delay-line construct and there is no way to store and replay audio after a time offset; the effect collapses to plain mixing. Removal test passes.

The flanger is built for the sake of digital-audio production: it persists as effect plugins, hardware units, and DSP code used in audio workflows. Remove digital-audio as the application domain, and the flanger's primary sustained practice and purpose vanish — no one uses a flanger outside of digital audio contexts. Servant (flanger) points at master (digital-audio).

Parallel compression is a specific kind of audio effect: it intentionally alters a sound signal by blending compressed and dry versions to change dynamics. Specific->general holds, nearest kind is audio-effect.

AIC is built for the sake of model selection: it was explicitly designed as a criterion for selecting among statistical models by estimating relative information loss. For whose sake? Model selection. Servant (AIC) → master (model-selection). Law 8d.

Serves test (Law 8d, for whose sake): the vocoder was built for whose sake? Human speech. Homer and Flono's 1928 vocoder analyzed speech into formant-band envelopes and resynthesized it for transmission — the parameters it preserves (band envelope amplitudes) are precisely the speech parameters, and its original and continuing primary application is speech analysis and transmission. It is not an ambient discipline (contrast: X DEPENDS_ON mathematics strikes) — speech-processing is the specific purpose-built discipline the device was constructed for. Direction: vocoder (servant) -> speech-processing (master). Pinned sense: speech-processing as the discipline the vocoder was built to serve, not as a category it belongs to (hence SERVES, not INSTANCE_OF).
Digital ledger IS a specific kind of ledger: it is a digital/electronic record-keeping system, often distributed. Specific→general. Nearest kind is 'ledger'.

A labyrinth is a physical structure composed of interconnecting walls that form a complex path. Walls are literal parts of a labyrinth — the structure IS made of walls arranged in a pattern. CONTAINS is the whole-part relation: labyrinth (whole) → wall (part).

Marginal likelihood p(x) = ∫ p(x|θ)π(θ)dθ is derived from the likelihood function p(x|θ) by integrating over the parameter space weighted by the prior. Likelihood was formalized by Fisher in the 1920s; marginal likelihood (model evidence) came later as the Bayesian extension. The likelihood is the base construct; marginal likelihood is its integrated variant.

Removal test (Law 8b): remove audio effects and the insert configuration stops operating — a series connection with no effect unit in it is a bare pass-through, not an insert-effect. The configuration is not identical to the effect (not identity, Law 8c) and it is not a purpose statement: the effect unit is the operative content the configuration exists around, the same shape as screwdriver DEPENDS_ON screw. Direction pinned: from=insert-effect (the configuration), to=audio-effect (the kind it requires).

Audio clock drift is a timing error that manifests in audio signal processing. It operates on the temporal alignment of audio signals — without signal as its material, the construct has nothing to measure drift against. The removal test passes: removing signal eliminates the medium in which clock drift is detectable and meaningful.
Formalism as a philosophical approach to mathematics depends on mathematics — without the subject matter of mathematics, formalism has no domain in which to operate.

Syllogism operates as a deductive reasoning form that requires logic to validate its structure — premises, inferences, and conclusions depend on logical criteria to distinguish valid from invalid forms. Remove logic (the study and principles of valid reasoning) and syllogism loses its framework for determining whether a deduction is valid. This is a genuine operational dependency: the practice of syllogistic reasoning requires logical criteria to function.

Differential entropy integrates log-density values; log-likelihood provides the fundamental logarithmic probability function that both differential entropy and log-likelihood itself operate on. The removal of log-probability computation destroys the structural basis of differential entropy.

Removal test (Law 8b): equalization operates on signals — it adjusts the relative amplitude of frequency components in an audio signal. Remove the signal and equalization has no material to process; it ceases to function. Same physical-interpretation precedent as accepted speaker→DEPENDS_ON signal, headphone-amplifier→DEPENDS_ON signal (pending).

A DAC's sole purpose is to transform one kind of signal (digital) into another (analog). Remove signal from the domain and the DAC has nothing to operate on — it stops functioning entirely. This is object-level dependency: signal is not a meta-level condition shared by all concepts, but the specific domain in which a DAC operates. The removal test passes cleanly.

Audio monitoring is a human-made system built for the sake of audio engineering: it provides real-time listening to assess capture, processing, and reproduction decisions. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

Harmonic exciter generates harmonic distortion by mixing the input with a generated signal; the excitation signal is produced by an oscillator. Remove the oscillator and the harmonic generation stops operating.

Wah-pedal is a specific kind of audio effect: it intentionally alters a guitar signal by sweeping a bandpass filter's center frequency, producing a distinctive timbral change. A competent audio engineer would call a wah-pedal an audio effect. Nearest kind per Law 11e: audio-effect (between wah-pedal and the broader signal-processing). Direction: specific→general per Law 9.

A catchword is a specific kind of word — one chosen for its ability to summarize a topic, attract attention, or serve as a mnemonic. A competent speaker would call it 'a type of word' (specifically, a word used in a particular way). This files against the nearest existing kind.

Conditional entropy H(Y|X) extends Shannon entropy H(X) to the setting of dependent variables. Entropy existed first (Shannon 1948) and conditional entropy was derived from it by introducing the conditioning variable. The chain rule H(X,Y)=H(X)+H(Y|X) shows conditional entropy as the extension of entropy to joint distributions.

comparator needs comparison to operate: a comparator's function is to compare two signals/values. Remove comparison and the comparator stops working — there is nothing to compare. The removal test passes.

Speech intelligibility is a quality metric computed to evaluate and guide signal processing systems that enhance, compress, or transmit speech. It serves signal processing by providing the target objective that processing algorithms optimize for.

Tape saturation is a specific kind of audio processing — the technique of processing audio through magnetic tape to add harmonics, soft compression, and color. Nearest kind: audio-processing. Direction: tape-saturation→audio-processing per Law 9.

A digital-to-analog-converter is built and maintained for the sake of audio engineering practice: it reconstructs analog waveforms from digital audio for monitoring, playback, and recording chain operation. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

Syllogism is a specific form of deductive reasoning: a structured argument where conclusions follow necessarily from premises. Direction: specific (syllogism) → general (deductive-reasoning). A competent speaker would call syllogism a deductive-reasoning pattern. Nearest kind: deductive-reasoning is more specific than logic (my previous DEPENDS_ON→logic error), and syllogism IS a kind of deductive-reasoning.
Partial dependence plot is a specific statistical method for interpreting machine learning models, visualizing marginal effects. It is a concrete instance of statistical method.

A delay-line produces a specific frequency response by feeding delayed copies of a signal back — this IS a filtering operation (comb filtering). A competent speaker would call a delay-line 'a type of filter' in the context of signal processing.
notion as a digital workspace is built and maintained for the sake of knowledge management, providing structured capture and retrieval of ideas.

tape-loop IS a specific kind of delay mechanism: it produces audio delay through a physical tape loop with head spacing and tape speed determining the delay time. A competent engineer would describe it as a physical delay device. Nearest kind: delay (ACCEPTED).

The phase-locked vocoder is a speech synthesis technique specifically designed for speech processing — its purpose is to process and synthesize speech signals with phase coherence. Servant (phase-locked-vocoder) points at master (speech-processing).

Pinned sense (Law 11d): the classic Butterworth design as realized recursively — the maximally-flat prototype |H(jw)|=1/sqrt(1+(w/wc)^(2N)) carried to the digital domain by bilinear transform, with poles inside the unit circle and feedback in the difference equation. That realization is a specific member of the recursive filter class: a competent speaker calls a Butterworth IIR section an IIR filter. Nearest kind (Law 11e): iir-filter — no nearer recursive-kind rung exists in the web. FIR approximations of the Butterworth magnitude are a secondary sense, not the pinned one.

Removal test: converter's accepted carve assigns it the sole function of transforming a signal (or the quantity a signal carries) from one representational domain to another. Remove the signal and there is nothing to convert — no input to the transformation, so the device has no operation left to perform and stops operating. Pinned sense: the signal as the input the converter's operation processes, not a generic conceptual need. Cluster precedent: stereo, audio-processing, and audio-engineering all carry accepted DEPENDS_ON signal on the same functional reading.

Preamp is built and maintained for the sake of audio engineering practice: it amplifies weak microphone/instrument signals to usable line level as the first gain stage in recording, mixing, and broadcast chains. Its design parameters — gain, impedance matching, noise figure, phantom power — are defined by engineering requirements of audio signal handling, not by generic electronics alone.

An indictment requires a court system to operate — without courts (judicial institutions that receive and process formal charges), the indictment mechanism ceases to function. This passes the Law 8b removal test: remove courts and indictments stop operating (not merely stop being sayable). Distinguish from existing indictment DEPENDS_ON law: law provides the abstract framework, court provides the operational institution.

KL divergence D_KL(P||Q) = -∑ P(x) log Q(x) + ∑ P(x) log P(x) = cross-entropy(P,Q) - entropy(P). KL is decomposed as cross-entropy minus entropy. Shannon introduced cross-entropy (1948) first; KL (Kullback-Leibler, 1951) was derived from it as a divergence measure. Which-came-first: cross-entropy predates KL divergence.
Digital-to-analog-converter is built to reconstruct analog waveforms for audio playback and monitoring, a core function within audio engineering practice. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

MFCC computation requires multiple signal processing steps: FFT for spectral analysis, mel filterbank application, and DCT. Each step is a signal processing operation — removing signal processing stops the entire MFCC pipeline. Present-tense constitutive dependency.

A canon is a bounded collection of texts whose selection principle is authority/orthodoxy — exactly the corpus parameter that determines membership. The canon of literature, scripture, and music is a corpus of works filtered by canonical status; a competent speaker calls the canon a corpus. Law 9: X is a specific kind of Y, and corpus is the NEAREST kind (no narrower 'authoritative text collection' exists). Sense pinned to the primary works/texts reading; 'canon of principles' is the secondary sense.
Algorithmic reverbs rely on feedback loops to sustain and diffuse reflections. Remove feedback and the tail collapses; the reverberant field stops building.

Cepstral peak prominence quantifies periodicity strength per frame and is built for the sake of voice-activity-detection tasks where periodicity discriminates speech from non-speech. The metric is used as a feature to drive VAD decisions; remove CPP and VAD loses a periodicity-based cue and its operation degrades. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

windowed-sinc-interpolation IS a specific kind of signal-processing technique — it reconstructs a continuous signal from samples using a sinc kernel modulated by a window function. The nearest kind is signal-processing: operations on signals. Direction is specific→general.

A spectral flanger operates through phase-vocoder analysis-synthesis: it decomposes the signal into phase-vocoder bins, applies time-varying delay modulation, and resynthesizes. Remove phase-vocoder and the spectral-flanger's mechanism collapses — there is no alternative to phase vocoding for the spectral analysis required. The dependency is constitutive: the effect IS a phase-vocoder with modulation applied.

A workbench is a kind of furniture: a movable human-made object designed to support a specific human activity (standing craft work at a surface) through an engineered form-function relation — top plus support structure. Nearest-kind rung: no intermediate work-surface entry exists between workbench and furniture (same rung the accepted desk INSTANCE_OF furniture uses). Dir test: a workbench is a kind of furniture, not the reverse; a competent speaker calls a workbench 'a piece of (workshop) furniture'.

An analog-to-digital-converter is built and maintained for the sake of audio engineering practice: it digitizes microphone and instrument signals for recording, editing, and processing within the studio workflow. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

A headphone-amplifier is a specific kind of amplifier: it amplifies audio signals using electronic gain stages, just like any amplifier, but with output characteristics specifically optimized for driving headphones (high voltage swing, appropriate output impedance). A competent audio engineer would classify a headphone-amplifier as 'a type of amplifier.'

An analog-to-digital-converter IS a transducer — it transforms analog electrical signals into digital representations. The converter operates by transducing continuous voltage levels into discrete digital codes. This is nearest-kind: transducer is the direct parent class for devices that convert between physical and digital signal domains.

Phase coherence measurement requires the concept of audio phase as its input representation; remove audio phase and phase coherence cannot be evaluated or computed, so the construct stops operating. Operational dependency, not merely sayable. Law 8b removal test satisfied.

Overlap-save needs FFT to operate: its core mechanism is computing the FFT of overlapping signal blocks, multiplying in frequency domain, then IFFT-ing back. Remove FFT and overlap-save ceases to function. This passes the removal test (Law 8).

A phase-locked loop is a feedback control circuit that operates by processing a signal — it compares input phase against a reference and generates a correction signal. Remove signal-processing and the PLL cannot function.

Falsifiability as a theory of knowledge criterion depends on epistemology — without epistemology's framework for evaluating belief justification, falsifiability cannot serve as a demarcation standard.

Law 8d 'for whose sake?': EM is built to find maximum-likelihood (and MAP) parameter estimates in models with unobserved latent variables — that estimation task is its designed purpose, and its two steps (E-step posterior, M-step maximization of the expected complete-data log-likelihood) exist only to produce the MLE. Servant (the iterative algorithm) points at master (the estimation method it was built for). Service need not be exclusive (it also serves MAP estimation); the pinned sense is MLE as the primary designed target.

audio-dithering IS a DSP technique that adds noise before quantization to decorrelate quantization error. Its entire mechanism (noise shaping, amplitude control, bit-depth processing) requires signal-processing fundamentals. Remove signal-processing and audio dithering stops operating.

Spectrogram is a visualization technique built and maintained for audio engineering practice: it provides time-frequency analysis for analysis, mixing, mastering, and diagnostics. Servant points at master per Law 8d; pinned sense is the audio engineering visualization, not general signal processing.

filter-design's accepted definition carves 'the structured practice of creating filters ... selecting an appropriate filter topology, computing coefficients or component values using synthesis methods (window method, bilinear transform, Chebyshev or elliptic approximation)'. Historically that practice — first analog (Butterworth/Chebyshev second-order prototypes), then digitized — is what produced the biquad: the bilinear transform maps a second-order analog prototype onto a second-order digital section, and realizing higher-order designs as cascaded second-order sections is a design-method choice for numerical stability. The practice existed first and fed into the biquad's form and its five-coefficient parameterization. This is historical origin (Law 7), not dependency: a biquad operates with no filter-design practice ongoing.

upward-expansion DEPENDS_ON gain: the accepted definition states it 'increases the gain of a signal when its level falls below a threshold.' The removal test passes — remove gain (the measure of amplification factor) and upward expansion ceases to operate: it has no mechanism to manipulate, no parameter to change. This is not a meta-level dependence; it's the core operational mechanism of the technique.

Overlap-save is an FFT-based linear convolution method that fundamentally requires windowing: segments of the input signal must be windowed before FFT to reduce spectral leakage. Remove the concept of windowing and overlap-save ceases to operate — the algorithm cannot function without applying a window function to its signal segments. Present-tense removal test passes.

A de-esser is a specific kind of audio effect: it intentionally alters a sound signal by attenuating sibilant high-frequency energy, producing a version distinguishable from the unprocessed source. Nearest kind per Law 11e is audio-effect, not broader dynamic-processor or signal-processing.

Phase vocoder is built for pitch-shift (and time-stretch): it computes STFT → phase-unwraps → resamples frequency bins → ISTFT to shift pitch while preserving duration. Remove pitch-shift as a use-case and the phase vocoder's primary sustained application domain vanishes.

Ring modulator is a specific kind of audio effect: it intentionally alters a sound signal to produce sum/difference frequencies, which is the carve in audio-effect definition. Nearest kind per Law 11e: audio-effect sits between ring-modulator and signal-processing.

An epistemic loop is a specific pattern of cognitive bias: a self-reinforcing cycle where one's beliefs prevent acquisition of disconfirming evidence. It files as specific→general against cognitive-bias (the nearest accepted kind). The sense pinned is the epistemological concept — a structural flaw in belief updating, not merely a heuristic shortcut.

windowed-sinc-interpolation requires a window function to truncate the infinite sinc kernel into a finite computable sum; removing the window function eliminates the finite form and the interpolator cannot operate.

Chi-squared divergence is constructed as a computationally convenient divergence for comparing distributions, specifically used within goodness-of-fit testing and model comparison. It is built for the sake of evaluating how well a model fits observed data, i.e., it serves goodness-of-fit practice.

Oscillator technology derives from feedback theory. The Barkhausen criterion (the fundamental condition for oscillation in linear circuits) was established through feedback analysis. Historical timeline: feedback as a concept (18th c. governors, 1920s Nyquist/Black formalization) predates and enabled modern oscillator design (Hartley 1915, Colpitts 1918, both using feedback topologies). The oscillator concept is built on feedback theory.

Compressor DEPENDS_ON gain as its core operational mechanism: it operates by reducing gain (gain reduction) when the signal exceeds a threshold. Remove gain — the measure of amplification factor that the compressor manipulates — and the compressor ceases to operate because gain reduction is its core mechanism; without gain there is no lever for the compressor to act on. Consistent with accepted precedent: upward-expansion DEPENDS_ON gain, saturator DEPENDS_ON gain, compression DEPENDS_ON gain.

Removal test (Laws 8a/8b): the delay definition's mechanism IS the delay line — 'the input is stored in a delay line (tape loop, bucket-brigade device, or digital buffer), the stored copy is retrieved after the delay time'. Remove the delay line and there is no storage, no retrieval, no repeat to return; the technique reduces to plain mixing. The delay line is an operative component of the circuit, constitutive to delay's operation, not an ambient formalism. Contrast with reverb->delay-line (correctly struck): there the definition covers spring, plate, and chamber mechanisms, so pinning to delay-line caught only a subset; here the defined mechanism is the delay line in all its instantiations, so the pin covers the whole defined endpoint. Pinned sense: delay-line as the storage-and-retrieval element. Direction: delay (dependent) -> delay-line (dependency).

Equalization is a human-made technique built and maintained for the sake of audio engineering practice: it provides the frequency-shaping operation used throughout recording chains, mastering, live sound, and sound design. Servant points at master per Law 8d. Consistent with accepted SERVES edges from signal-amplification→audio-engineering, tape-saturation→audio-engineering, phase-vocoder→audio-engineering.

decimation IS a specific kind of signal-processing technique — it reduces the sampling rate of a signal by keeping only every Nth sample. The nearest kind is signal-processing: operations on signals. Direction is specific→general.

A Kalman filter IS a specific kind of statistical estimator: it estimates hidden states from noisy measurements using a recursive rule. Specific→general mapping against the nearest kind (statistical-estimator). Law 9.

Removal test (Laws 8a/8b): chorus definition states it 'applies a low-frequency oscillator to vary the pitch (typically ±5–20 cents) and delay time (typically 15–40 ms) of each copy.' Without the LFO, chorus has no modulation — the copies are static, producing no thickening or shimmering effect. The LFO is constitutive to chorus operation. Pinned sense: LFO as the modulator varying pitch and delay time in the chorus algorithm. Direction: chorus (dependent) → lfo (dependency).

Phase response is a specific signal-processing concept describing the frequency-dependent phase shift introduced by a system, expressed as the argument (angle) of the complex frequency response H(jω). It is an instance of signal-processing — the discipline of algorithms and methods for analyzing and transforming signals. Sense pinned: phase response as the angular component of frequency response, not the colloquial sense of reacting to something.

The score function s(θ) = ∂/∂θ log p(x|θ) predates Fisher information. Fisher information I(θ) = E[s(θ)²] is defined as the expected squared score. Historical: score function used in likelihood theory before Fisher formalized the information concept (1925).

Analogical reasoning depends on logic: the method requires logical operations (mapping relations between domains, inferring shared properties) to function. Remove logic and analogical reasoning has no operational structure — it cannot map relations or infer properties. This is object-level, not meta-level (not 'concepts need language').

The exemplar's accepted definition is 'a model manuscript — a master copy carefully produced and corrected for scribes to reproduce.' A manuscript is carved as a human-made handwritten or typed document predating mechanical printing, produced by deliberate inscription. An exemplar master copy is exactly such a document — its definition literally calls it a model manuscript. Nearest kind: manuscript, closer than document (Law 11e).
cepstral-coefficients are computed via signal-processing operations (FFT, log, DCT). Removing signal-processing stops the computation pipeline. Present-tense removal test passes.

An epigraph IS a specific kind of quotation — it is a brief quotation deliberately placed at the beginning of a work to set interpretive frame. A competent speaker would call an epigraph 'a kind of quotation' qualified by its placement and purpose. Per Law 9: specific→general.

Remove signal-processing and the delay-line construct cannot operate — a delay-line implements a time-shift operation on signals, which requires the signal-processing capability. The mechanism (buffered read/write with offset) is a signal-processing technique.

Mutual information I(X;Y) = D_KL(p(x,y) || p(x)p(y)) — its definition is literally the KL-divergence between the joint distribution and the product of marginals. Remove KL-divergence and mutual-information has no definition. Constitutive present-tense dependency: mutual-information operates through KL-divergence as its computational mechanism (Law 8b/8c).

Speech intelligibility measures how well spoken language is understood by a listener. It depends on psychoacoustics — the study of how the human auditory system perceives sound — because intelligibility is fundamentally about perceptual processing: how the brain decodes acoustic signals. Without psychoacoustics as the framework for understanding auditory perception, speech-intelligibility cannot operate as a measurable concept.

Collation is a specific kind of practice — the practice of gathering and arranging information in proper order. A competent speaker would classify it as 'a practice' of assembly. Direction: specific (collation) → general (practice) per Law 9.

The sampling theorem (Nyquist-Shannon) establishes the conditions for perfect reconstruction of continuous signals from discrete samples and serves signal processing by providing the foundational principle for all digital signal processing — without it, the conversion from analog to digital would lack theoretical guarantees.

Tape saturation is a human-made audio effect technique built and maintained for the purpose of audio engineering practice — shaping timbre, adding harmonic color, and providing soft compression in mixing and mastering. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

A chorus is a specific kind of audio effect: it intentionally alters a sound signal to thicken and enrich it through duplicated, modulated copies. A competent speaker would call a chorus 'an audio effect'. The nearest kind is audio-effect, not the broader modulation or signal-processing.

Tape-saturation is a specific kind of saturation — the nonlinear compression and harmonic generation that occurs when magnetic tape exceeds its optimal flux level. A competent speaker would classify tape saturation as a type of saturation. This is the nearest kind: saturation.

Gain staging is a specific kind of signal processing: it is the practice of adjusting signal amplitude at each stage of a chain to optimize level relationships. It modifies signal characteristics (amplitude at each point) and is a recognized form of signal manipulation in audio engineering.

Conjecture is the activity of forming a tentative explanation or hypothesis for further investigation. It requires logic as its operating framework — without logic, conjecture cannot formulate propositions, evaluate consistency, or guide inference. The removal test passes: remove logic and conjecture loses its reasoning mechanism entirely.

A vocoder (voice encoder) processes audio signals — it analyzes input and produces modified output through synthesis. It is a specific kind of audio processing device/effect. A competent audio engineer would classify a vocoder under audio effects. Files against the nearest kind — audio-effect.

Analogical reasoning is deployed as a teaching method: mapping unfamiliar concepts onto familiar ones to facilitate comprehension. Law 8d: for whose sake? Teaching is the master — the construct of analogical reasoning exists in pedagogical contexts to further teaching's operation. Servant (analogical-reasoning) points at master (teaching).
test-shift-entry is a specific instance of test-entry-seth kind, sharing test parameters and persistence.
Windowed sinc interpolation is a specific implementation of interpolation; removing the general interpolation operation makes the windowed sinc variant inoperable as a reconstruction method.
Amplitude-modulation is a specific kind of modulation technique: varying the amplitude of a carrier signal in proportion to a modulating signal. Nearest kind is modulation itself.

Self-information I(x) = -log p(x) shares the log-probability structure with log-likelihood L(θ) = log p(x|θ), which predates self-information historically (Fisher 1920s vs Shannon 1948). The mathematical operation of taking the log of a probability density is the common building block; self-information specializes this to the negative for a single event under its own distribution. Which came first: log-likelihood as a structural concept (yes). DERIVED_FROM tests historical precedence and conceptual lineage.

Headphone-stand is built/maintained for the sake of audio engineering practice: it holds headphones to prevent damage, keep workspaces organized, and support quick access during mixing and monitoring sessions.

A scheme is a specific kind of classification system — it organizes items into categories or types (e.g. classification schemes in biology, library science). 'A scheme is a kind of classification system.'

A subwoofer is a specific kind of speaker: an electro-acoustic transducer whose driver, enclosure, and amplifier channel are dedicated to the low-frequency band. A competent speaker would call a subwoofer 'a kind of speaker.' 'loudspeaker' is not filed, so speaker is the nearest available kind - a single-rung specific->general (Law 9/11e), not a leap.

A flanger processes audio signals for creative effect; remove flanger and digital-audio production loses a core timbral-shaping technique. The flanger is built for the sake of digital-audio artists and producers.
A linear-phase filter is a specific kind of FIR filter — it uses a symmetric impulse response to produce constant group delay. Nearest kind: fir-filter.

For whose sake: compression is designed and maintained for audio-engineering, controlling dynamic range, increasing perceived loudness, and shaping transients across mixing and mastering. Servant→master.

Cepstral peak prominence is a specific kind of audio-feature: a per-frame scalar descriptor extracted from a speech (audio) signal via cepstral computation, used for voice-quality analysis and classification — it fits audio-feature's accepted definition exactly (numeric descriptor derived from a digital audio signal through computational processing, serving downstream classification tasks). Nearest existing kind is audio-feature: no cepstral-feature or speech-feature entry exists. This completes the ladder cpp -> audio-feature -> feature, where audio-feature INSTANCE_OF feature is already ACCEPTED (Law 11e).

A partial dependence plot is a specific type of visual encoding used to interpret machine learning models. It visualizes the marginal effect of one or two features on the predicted outcome using a plotted relationship, where the x-axis shows feature values and the y-axis shows predicted response. It is a concrete kind of visual encoding.

Phase coherence is a signal-processing metric that requires DSP algorithms (DFT/STFT analysis, phase extraction, correlation computation) to measure. Remove signal processing and phase coherence has no mechanism for measurement or computation. This is a constitutive dependency.

preamp DEPENDS_ON signal: the accepted preamp definition states its purpose is to 'increase the amplitude of a weak input signal.' Remove the concept of signal and preamp ceases to operate: it has no input to amplify, no signal path, no operational target. Same pattern as gain, filter, impulse-response which all DEPEND_ON signal.

A conjecture is a proposition asserted without complete proof — its identity as a conjecture is constitutively dependent on having the concept of proposition (a declarative statement that can be true or false). Without proposition, conjecture cannot exist as a category. Direction: conjecture (newer, dependent) → proposition (older, foundational).
Retroduction is a named historical form of abductive reasoning; specific instance of the general abductive class, nearest kind.

The Rényi divergence is a named family of statistical divergences — the umbrella's own accepted definition names it explicitly: 'the Kullback–Leibler, Jensen–Shannon, chi-squared, and Rényi families are all special cases or variants of the broader concept of statistical divergence.' Law 11e nearest kind: it is NOT an f-divergence (its (1/(α−1))·log Σ P^α Q^(1−α) form does not reduce to the f-divergence form f(t) = t·f′(1/(1−t)) family), so statistical-divergence — the accepted umbrella that names it — is the nearest existing kind. A statistician says 'Rényi divergence is a statistical divergence'. Specific → general.

A sampler records and replays audio at precise sample rates. Remove the clock — sample playback timing becomes unstable and pitch drifts — and the sampler cannot reproduce audio accurately. Clock-driven timing is essential to the sampling operation.

Formant vocoder extracts formant frequencies, bandwidths and excitation parameters from speech spectra per frame. Removing spectral analysis removes the input representation on which formant tracking operates, so the vocoder cannot perform analysis or synthesis.

Fisher information I(θ) = Var(∂/∂θ log L(θ;X)) = E[(∂/∂θ log L)²]. It is the variance of the score function — remove the score function and Fisher information has no definable quantity. The score is the fundamental object; Fisher info is a moment of it.

Tape delay produces echoes by recording onto a moving magnetic tape loop and playing it back after mechanical delay. Remove the tape-loop mechanism and the delay apparatus has no medium to record/playback on; the effect stops operating.

Specific to general (Law 9): the Wiener filter is a filter in the target's pinned sense — its accepted definition's frequency-domain solution H(f) = S_x(f)/(S_x(f)+S_n(f)) is exactly a designed transfer function that selectively passes or attenuates frequency components (weighted by local SNR), matching the accepted def of 'filter' (selective pass/attenuation per designed transfer function). Nearest kind (Law 11e): no 'optimal-filter' or 'adaptive-filter' rung exists, and iir-filter is the wrong rung — the Wiener filter is defined by the MMSE criterion, not recursion; finite-length Wiener solutions are FIR. Servant-of relations (SERVES speech-enhancement) are a separate matter; this pins the kind-membership sense.

DEPENDS_ON removal test: audio jitter IS timing variation — and timing variation can only be measured/defined relative to a reference clock. Remove the clock and there is no reference against which to measure or even define jitter. Jitter has no operational meaning without a clock.

Flow diagram is a specific visual encoding technique that represents processes or relationships with nodes and directed paths. It maps abstract process data to visual marks, fitting the pinned sense of visual encoding as data-to-visual mapping.

Limen (the threshold of perception) IS defined by its role in perception — it marks the boundary below which stimuli are not perceived. Remove perception and limen ceases to exist as a perceptual threshold. The concept is constitutively tied to perception; without perception, there is no limen.

Present-tense necessity (Law 8b): the empirical distribution is a functional ON the sample — F_n(x) = (1/n)·Σ 1{X_i ≤ x} is defined over the sample values, and the entry's own carve says it 'describes observed data values from a finite sample.' Remove the sample now and the functional has no domain to operate on: there is nothing to describe, no F_n to compute — it stops OPERATING, it is not merely sayable. Not an ambient dependency (contrast: X DEPENDS_ON mathematics = STRIKE): the sample is the specific operational input, the same functional→input pattern as variance→probability-distribution and MLE→likelihood. (Note: the 'data' entry carves data CLEANING, so it is not the correct substrate; the carve's named input is the sample.)

Law 9 specific-to-general, nearest kind: sample-rate-converter's accepted carve is 'a device or algorithm that changes the sampling frequency of a digital audio signal by resampling, preserving pitch and duration' — input form: digital signal at one sample rate, output form: digital signal at another rate, transformation law: resampling kernel with interpolation and filtering. A form-to-form transformation preserving information content, i.e. converter's carve. The device (not the technique 'sample-rate-conversion') is the instance; converter is the nearest accepted kind.

Flangers are built for digital audio processing workflows — the effect is implemented as a software plugin or digital hardware unit. Remove digital-audio and flangers lose their primary application domain and purpose. Flangers serve the digital-audio ecosystem.

Merge conflict is an artifact that arises when version-control detects incompatible divergences in a file's history and cannot auto-reconcile them. Removing version-control removes the history tracking and merge operation that produce the conflict, so the conflict cannot be generated or persisted.

Mid-side processing is a specific audio technique that encodes stereo signals into sum (mid) and difference (side) components. It is a particular kind of audio-processing operation, not a general class or a whole-part relation. Nearest kind: audio-processing.

Log-likelihood computation requires the likelihood function which itself depends on probability distributions; KL divergence is the canonical divergence between distributions that log-likelihood evaluates, and the mathematical structure of likelihood underpins how KL divergence measures information loss.

A gloss is a brief explanation, translation, or annotation of a word or term. It operates within a vocabulary — remove the concept of vocabulary (a body of words and their meanings) and a gloss has nothing to explain or translate. This is a genuine DEPENDS_ON removal test.

Formant vocoder is built and maintained for the sake of audio processing: it enables creative voice synthesis, vocal timbre manipulation, and sound design in music production beyond speech processing. Its parameters (formant frequency tracks, bandwidths, excitation) are applied in audio workflows for vocal synthesis and voice conversion. Servant points at master per Law 8d. Consistent with phase-locked-vocoder's dual SERVES to audio-processing and speech-processing.

A low-frequency oscillator is a specific modulation technique where a signal with low frequency is used to modulate a parameter of another signal. Competent speaker test: LFO is a kind of modulation (specifically, parameter modulation via low-frequency oscillation). Specific→general, nearest kind.

Fisher information I(θ) = E[(∂/∂θ log L(θ;X))²] = -E[∂²/∂θ² log L(θ;X)] operates directly on log-likelihood. Remove log-likelihood and Fisher information has no mathematical object to differentiate or evaluate — it ceases to exist. Direction correct: Fisher information (derived concept) depends on log-likelihood (the object it operates on). Note: Fisher info can also be defined via the score function's variance, but score-function itself depends on log-likelihood.

ducking IS a specific application of the sidechain technique: it is sidechain-based dynamics processing where the purpose is to reduce background audio when foreground audio is present. Nearest kind: sidechain (PROVISIONAL). The sidechain is the general routing pattern; ducking is a specific instance of that pattern.

A syllogism is a specific form of deductive reasoning where a conclusion is drawn from two or more premises. A competent speaker would call a syllogism 'a form of deduction.' This files against the nearest kind.

ADC IS a specific kind of transducer — it transduces a continuous analog signal into a discrete digital signal, converting between signal domains. Same class as DAC→transducer. Nearest kind: transducer covers any device converting energy/signals across domains.

Overlap-save IS a specific kind of convolution method: it performs linear convolution via overlapping blocks in the frequency domain. A competent speaker would call overlap-save a convolution technique. Nearest kind: convolution (ACCEPTED).

A pull request is a specific version control mechanism for proposing and reviewing code changes. It is a specific kind of version control operation — a competent speaker would call it 'a version control [mechanism/process]'.

A sample clock provides the timing reference for sampling — it determines the rate at which analog signals are converted to digital. The removal test: remove sampling and a sample clock has no purpose or context. The clock exists to synchronize sampling operations.

Fisher information was derived from studying the likelihood function: it quantifies the curvature of the log-likelihood, measuring how much information the observable random variable carries about an unknown parameter. Fisher (1925) derived this from the likelihood's second derivative — which-came-first: likelihood function predates Fisher information.
A compressor is a specific kind of signal processing device/algorithm that performs dynamic range reduction. A competent speaker would call a compressor 'a signal processing tool.' Nearest kind.

A sufficient statistic T(X) is defined by the factorization P(X|theta) = g(T(X),theta)·h(X) — the likelihood function. Remove likelihood and the concept of sufficiency has no mechanism to operate on. Present-tense operational necessity: sufficient statistics extract information from likelihood, not from data alone.

Ensemble learning needs models as its building blocks: the technique combines multiple models' predictions to produce improved results. Remove models and ensemble learning collapses — there are no base predictions to combine. This passes the removal test: the mechanism literally operates on models.

insert-effect IS a specific kind of audio-routing: it is a routing configuration where an effect unit is placed in series within a signal chain, directing the signal through the effect between source and destination. A competent engineer classifies insert effect as a form of audio routing. Direction: specific→general per Law 9. Nearest kind: audio-routing.

A treatise is a specific kind of book — a formal, systematic written discourse on a particular subject. A competent speaker would call a treatise 'a book.' The entry 'book' exists and is the nearest kind; no existing INSTANCE_OF ladder leap exists.

FIR filters operate on discrete-time digital signals. The sampling theorem (Nyquist-Shannon) provides the theoretical foundation for converting continuous signals to discrete form — without it, digital signal processing including FIR filtering has no theoretical basis for how continuous signals can be faithfully represented in discrete form.

An LFO is a kind of oscillator whose frequency parameter is restricted to the sub-audible band (conventionally 0.01-20 Hz): same construct, same two operating mechanisms (sustained periodic output from steady power), one narrowed parameter range. Nearest kind (Law 11e): there is no middle rung between 'low-frequency oscillator' and 'oscillator' — the LFO is the oscillator with the low-frequency constraint. Pinned sense (Law 11d): the is-a relation, not a dependency — an LFO stops being an LFO only when it stops oscillating, which is its identity as a kind of oscillator. specific->general direction (Law 9).

Spectral flatness is computed from the power spectrum: the measure is the ratio of geometric mean to arithmetic mean of the spectral power values. Remove the power spectrum and the flatness calculation has no input and stops operating.

Mel-cepstral distortion is a distance metric computed from mel-frequency cepstral coefficients — it quantifies spectral distortion between reference and processed speech by comparing coefficient vectors. The removal test passes: without cepstral coefficients as the computational substrate, the distortion metric cannot be computed or operate. Direction: mel-cepstral-distortion depends on cepstral-coefficients.

Cepstral mean normalization operates on cepstral coefficients produced by cepstral analysis; without the analysis output there is nothing to normalize. Removing cepstral analysis prevents the mean normalization step from operating on the intended data.

An LFO (Low-Frequency Oscillator) is a signal generator whose operation requires the oscillator mechanism. Remove oscillators and the LFO produces no signal. It is a specific application of oscillation — the oscillator is its constitutive operating mechanism.

Phase-locked vocoder extracts and manipulates phase information from speech frames within the speech-processing pipeline. Removing speech-processing removes the frame-based analysis, phase estimation, and synthesis pipeline that the vocoder operates within. Constitutive: without speech-processing providing this pipeline, the phase-locked vocoder has no operational framework.

Griffin-Lim is an iterative phase retrieval algorithm built and maintained for the sake of audio processing: it reconstructs time-domain audio from magnitude spectrograms, enabling audio inpainting and vocoder applications. Servant points at master.

A minimum-phase filter is a signal processing construct whose defining property (minimum phase shift for given magnitude response) serves the practical needs of signal processing — ensuring causal, stable inverse filtering and minimal delay. Its design purpose is signal processing applications. Law 8d: servant points at master.

audio-frame is a human-made unit of audio data, a contiguous block of samples processed as a single chunk in streaming and real-time systems. It is a specific kind of audio-processing operation, not a general class, and sits directly under audio-processing per Law 9 nearest kind.

A phase-locked loop is a feedback control system that contains a voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO). Remove the oscillator — the element that generates the output frequency — and the PLL has no signal to lock, compare, or control. The oscillator is a constitutive component, not merely historical. Removal test passes.

Spatialization is built and maintained for the sake of audio engineering practice: it provides spatial soundstage creation for recording, mixing, mastering, and playback, with parameters for spatial model and rendering method. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

Recency bias — the tendency to remember recent events better than older ones — is a specific cognitive tendency. Under Law 7, which-came-first: the general heuristic concept predates the specific recency bias. The bias is a named cognitive tendency derived from the broader heuristic concept.

Phase vocoder tracks phase progression across overlapping frames to maintain coherent pitch during time-scale modification. Without phase unwrapping to recover continuous phase from wrapped modulo-2π measurements, phase differences are ambiguous and phase propagation fails, so the vocoder stops operating correctly. Operational present-tense dependency, not historical.
Remove FFT — cepstral-peak-prominence stops operating. CPP is computed as the peak of the cepstrum, which requires FFT → log-spectrum → IFFT pipeline. Without DFT/FFT, no cepstrum can be computed.

Ring modulation is a specific modulation technique where two signals are multiplied together to produce sum and difference frequencies. Competent speaker test: ring modulation is a kind of modulation. Specific→general, nearest kind.
Formant vocoder is a specific implementation family within the broader vocoder technique class.

Spatialization is a specific kind of audio-routing. Audio-routing is the general practice of directing audio signals through a network of paths; spatialization is the particular routing technique that assigns signals to perceived positions in space. A competent speaker would call spatialization a form of routing.

Spectral flatness measure is computed and maintained specifically to support voice activity detection; low flatness indicates voiced speech, high flatness indicates unvoiced/noise, providing the discriminative feature VAD systems rely on.
Mindfulness is a specific cognitive practice and attentional regulation technique. Clean specific→general INSTANCE_OF (Law 9).

Information geometry is built and maintained for the sake of optimization — specifically natural gradient optimization uses the Fisher information metric to precondition gradients for more efficient optimization in curved parameter spaces. Law 8d: servant (information geometry) points at master (optimization).

A compressor is the concrete device/algorithm instantiating the dynamic-range-compression technique: its accepted definition (threshold, ratio, attack time, release — variable gain reduction above threshold) is the technique's accepted definition ('measuring the amplitude envelope and applying variable gain when the signal exceeds a threshold') made into hardware/software. Law 9: a specific kind of the general technique. Same ladder shape as the ALREADY ACCEPTED rungs limiter INSTANCE_OF dynamic-range-compression and de-essing INSTANCE_OF dynamic-range-compression — a compressor with finite ratio is the middle member of that family. Nearest kind per Law 11e: dynamic-range-compression, not the discipline above it (the DRC→signal-processing rung already exists as accepted, so the ladder reads compressor → DRC → signal-processing).

Flanger uses LFO to modulate the delay time of its feedback loop — this oscillation IS the flanging effect. Remove the LFO and the flanger stops producing its characteristic sweeping sound. The removal test passes: without lfo operating now, flanger ceases its function.

AIC = 2k - 2log(L) requires a statistical model: k is the number of free parameters, L is the maximum likelihood from fitting the model. Remove the statistical model and AIC ceases to operate — no model to count parameters from, no likelihood to evaluate. AIC is a model-comparison tool, not a standalone formula.

Bayes factor IS the ratio of marginal likelihoods. Remove marginal likelihood — you cannot compute a Bayes factor. Present-tense operational necessity: every Bayes factor computation requires evaluating marginal likelihoods under each model.

Harmonic-to-noise ratio is a voice-quality metric built for the purpose of assessing and controlling periodicity in speech enhancement; it is used to guide dereverberation and noise suppression decisions and to evaluate enhancement quality. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

Insert effect is a specific kind of audio effect: it is an effect unit placed in series within a signal chain, altering the signal's character. A competent engineer classifies insert effect as a form of audio effect. Nearest kind per Law 11e is audio-effect.

Gossip is built for the purpose of facilitating social communication — it circulates information, builds social bonds, and maintains group knowledge through informal channels. The servant (gossip) points at the master (communication). While it already has INSTANCE_OF→communication, SERVES adds the teleological dimension.

A crossover splits audio signals into frequency bands, which fundamentally requires frequency-domain analysis via the Fourier transform. Removal test: remove the Fourier transform method and a crossover has no mechanism to separate frequency components — it stops operating entirely. This is a present-tense operational dependency, not historical. Law 8 passes.

gain-staging sets operating levels to maximize the margin before distortion. Remove headroom (the concept of margin between nominal and maximum levels) and gain-staging loses its purpose and definition — it has no operation without the concept of headroom. Present-tense dependency.

Removal test: remove cognitive dissonance (mental discomfort from holding conflicting cognitions) and rationalization — the ego's strategy of constructing plausible but false explanations — loses its trigger. Rationalization exists as a response mechanism to dissonance; without dissonance there is no rationalizing to do. The psychological mechanism is dissonance reduction; rationalization is one pathway.
Remove the audio signal and the audio-interface has no input to convert, so recording and playback stop operating.

Cognitive-bias depends on memory: these are systematic deviations in judgment that operate on stored information (prior experiences, stored knowledge). Remove memory — the capacity to retain and retrieve past information — and there is no stored content for a bias to skew judgment about. The removal test passes.

Reverb cannot operate without delay-line — its mechanism IS feeding delayed signals back with decreasing amplitude to simulate acoustic space. The removal test (Law 8) passes: remove delay-line construct and reverb has no working mechanism. Direction: reverb (newer, 1930s electronic effect) DEPENDS_ON delay-line (older, fundamental signal processing construct).

Deposition requires the legal framework to operate — a deposition is a sworn out-of-court testimony governed by procedural rules of law. Remove law and depositions lose their legal standing, procedural rules, and enforcement mechanism. They stop operating as legal instruments.

Sidechain routing requires a dynamics processor with a sidechain input to operate; remove the compressor and the sidechain control path has no effector to modulate. The sidechain technique is operationally dependent on a compressor (or similar) to perform gain reduction in response to the external trigger.

Algorithmic reverb models acoustic reflections by routing delayed copies of the signal through networks of allpass and delay lines. Remove delay — the reflections cannot be spaced in time — and the reverberant field cannot be constructed. Delay lines are the fundamental building blocks of reverb architecture.
An audio bus is a specific routing channel that carries and mixes audio signals — a kind of audio-processing infrastructure.

Signal processing fundamentally requires mathematical operations to operate — Fourier transforms, convolutions, filtering all depend on mathematical theory. Remove mathematics and signal processing cannot perform any of its core operations. The removal test passes: without mathematics, signal processing ceases to function.

Feedback control is a specific kind of process where a system's output is fed back to adjust its input. The note pins the sense: a process is any systematic series of operations, and feedback control is that series configured with a feedback loop. Law 9: specific→general. Process is the nearest accepted kind.

A compressor IS a specific kind of dynamic-range-processing: it reduces the dynamic range of a signal by attenuating peaks above a threshold according to a set ratio. Competent speaker: 'a compressor is a type of dynamic range processor.' Nearest kind: dynamic-range-processing (not a leap — no intermediate rung exists). Law 9 passes.

A vocoder splits speech into frequency bands using an analysis filter bank and reshapes those bands through a synthesis filter bank. Remove the filter bank — spectral content cannot be extracted or reconstructed — and the vocoding mechanism stops operating. The filter bank is the structural core of both analysis and synthesis stages.

Bayes factors are built and maintained for the purpose of Bayesian model selection — they quantify evidence for one model over another to enable model choice. Servant (bayes-factor) points at master (model-selection). Per Law 8d: this records designed purpose, not constitutive need.

Remove oscillators from a synthesizer and it stops producing sound — oscillators generate the raw waveforms that the synthesizer shapes through filters and envelopes. A synthesizer needs oscillators operating now; the removal test confirms dependency.

A scholium is a specific kind of annotation: a critical or explanatory note added to a manuscript text by a reader or commentator. A competent speaker calls a scholium 'a type of annotation'. Nearest kind is annotation.

Presumption-of-innocence is a procedural rule within legal systems. Remove law (courts, enforcement, legal procedure) and the principle stops operating — it has no independent mechanism to function. The removal test (Law 8): without legal institutions, the presumption is merely a concept, not an operating principle. This is operational, not meta-level: the principle's mechanism (court enforcement, burden allocation at trial) collapses without law.

comb-filter DEPENDS_ON delay-line: The comb-filter's entire operational mechanism is the delay-and-add operation — it superimposes a delayed copy of the signal onto the original. Remove the delay-line construct (storage-and-retrieval-with-time-offset) and the comb-filter has no working mechanism: it cannot delay and add without a delay-line. The removal test passes at the object level, not the sayability level.

Tape-delay is a specific kind of delay-line: a device that stores and replays an audio signal after a fixed time delay. A competent speaker would call a tape delay a type of delay line. The nearest kind is delay-line, not tape-loop (which describes the mechanism, not the function).

Ring modulator multiplies a signal with a carrier. Remove the carrier oscillator and the multiplication has no carrier to operate on, so the ring modulator stops producing modulated output. Operational dependency, not historical.

Recency-bias is the tendency to remember recent events better than older ones. It directly depends on recall as its operating material: remove the ability to retrieve memories and the bias has no substrate on which to operate. Pinned sense: recall as the memory retrieval mechanism.

Score function U(θ;x)=∂/∂θ log L(θ;x) is defined only for a parametric statistical model p(x|θ). Remove the statistical model and the score has no parameter space, no likelihood, and no gradient to compute; it ceases to operate. Removal test satisfied.

A clipper IS a specific kind of distortion: it intentionally distorts a signal by truncating waveform peaks, producing flat-topped waveforms and harmonic content. A competent speaker would say 'a clipper is a distortion effect.' Nearest kind: distortion (ACCEPTED).

Reverb is a human-made technique built and maintained for the sake of audio engineering practice: it creates acoustic space perception used throughout recording, mixing, and sound design. Servant points at master per Law 8d. Consistent with accepted SERVES edges from signal-amplification→audio-engineering, tape-saturation→audio-engineering, phase-vocoder→audio-engineering.

Cross-entropy is used as the standard loss function for classification tasks, especially multi-class classification with softmax outputs. It is built and maintained for the sake of classification — quantifying the difference between predicted probability distributions and true class labels. Law 8d: servant (cross-entropy) points at master (classification).

Audio buffers are built and maintained for the sake of audio processing: they hold time-sliced audio data to decouple production and consumption rates, enable block processing, and provide the working memory for DSP algorithms. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

Limiting operates by detecting when signal exceeds a threshold and then reducing gain — typically via a feedback loop that senses the output level and adjusts accordingly. Remove the feedback mechanism and limiting stops working. This is the removal test of Law 8: without feedback, the limiter has no way to know the output has exceeded its threshold and cannot reduce gain.

Mel-cepstral distortion quantifies perceptual difference by computing RMS deviation of mel-cepstral coefficients. Remove cepstral analysis and the coefficients cannot be derived, so the metric stops operating.

sense-making is a specific kind of cognitive-strategy: a deliberate mental process of constructing meaning, interpretation, or understanding from information, experience, or data. Pin sense: cognitive-strategy as an organized mental approach for processing information. A competent speaker would call sense-making 'a cognitive strategy' — it is a structured approach to making sense of information.

Conditional entropy is a specific kind of entropy — the entropy of one random variable given knowledge of another. A competent speaker would call it 'an entropy measure' — it is a specific case within the general concept of entropy.

A pull request is an operational mechanism within version control systems — it requires the version control system (repository, branches, diffs) to function. Remove version control and a pull request cannot be created, merged, or reviewed. The which-came-first test: version-control predates pull-requests historically.

Tremolo cannot operate without an LFO: its defining mechanism IS an LFO generating a periodic waveform that modulates amplitude. Remove the LFO — the periodic amplitude variation that constitutes tremolo disappears. The LFO is the signal source that tremolo depends on for its core operation, not merely a tool it optionally uses.

Waveshaping operates by applying a nonlinear transfer function that produces harmonic distortion. Remove the mechanism of nonlinear distortion and waveshaping has no operating principle — the removal test is satisfied. Waveshaping IS a method of distortion generation.

Isomorphism requires abstraction to operate: identifying structural equivalence between two systems demands abstracting away their specific differences to see the shared form. Remove abstraction and isomorphism collapses — you cannot recognize structural sameness without abstracting details. This is the operating dependency, not mere conceptual dependence.

audio-processing operates on discrete samples; removing the audio-sample construct removes the data unit on which processing algorithms act, so the processing ceases to operate on its intended substrate.

Clipper operates on audio signals: it truncates the waveform above a threshold. Remove the signal and clipper has no signal to clip. Its operation requires signal as input, satisfying the Law 8 removal test.
DEPENDS_ON: remove perception, priming stops operating — the mechanism of prior stimulus exposure requires perceptual encoding to function.

Comparator in audio engineering is a tool or technique for comparing audio signals (e.g., phase comparators, level comparators, stereo comparators). It is built for the sake of audio-engineering: phase alignment, level matching, and stereo field analysis. Servant (comparator) points at master (audio-engineering) per Law 8d.

SNR is defined as the ratio of signal power to noise power (SNR = P_signal / P_noise). Remove the concept of signal and the ratio loses its numerator — there is no signal to measure, no signal power to compare. The removal test passes: SNR cannot operate without signal as a fundamental operand. Same shape as gain DEPENDS_ON signal (accepted).

Signal-amplification is a human-made technique built and maintained for the sake of audio engineering practice: it provides the fundamental gain-staging, preamplification, and power-amplification operations used throughout recording chains, monitoring systems, and live-sound reinforcement. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

The likelihood function was formalized by R.A. Fisher in the 1920s, treating the probability of the data as a function of the unknown parameters. The log-likelihood is the later computational re-parameterization: the natural logarithm of that function, adopted because it turns products into sums and makes maximum-likelihood optimization numerically stable — and its own accepted definition states it is 'the natural logarithm of the likelihood function'. The likelihood came first and gives rise to the log-likelihood; hence log-likelihood DERIVED_FROM likelihood (Law 7: which came first).

Law 9 specific-to-general, nearest kind: ADC's accepted carve is 'a hardware device that converts a continuous-time analog signal into a discrete-time, discrete-amplitude digital representation' — input form: continuous-time analog signal, output form: discrete-time/discrete-amplitude digital representation, transformation law: sampling plus quantization. Precisely converter's carve. No more specific kind node exists, so converter is the nearest accepted kind.

MLE estimates parameters of a statistical model — the model defines the likelihood family p(x|θ). Remove statistical models and MLE has no parameter space, no likelihood family, nothing to estimate. Epoch test confirms: MLE (0.01) newer than statistical-model (0), arrow MLE → statistical-model.

Formant vocoder operates on speech spectral data to manipulate formant structure. Without speech-processing providing the pipeline for spectral analysis, form extraction, and parameter estimation, the vocoder cannot operate — the removal test passes.

Probit model is a specific kind of statistical model used for binary outcome prediction. A competent speaker calls a probit model a type of model. Nearest kind: model (not a leap — model is the direct parent category).

tape-loop manipulates audio recorded on magnetic tape, creating effects like echo and reverb through physical tape movement and playback heads. Remove signal-processing (the analysis and manipulation of signals) and the tape-loop has no purpose — it operates on audio signals. Present-tense dependency.
Chi-squared divergence is the f-divergence generated by φ(t)=(t-1)². It is a specific kind of f-divergence, with its convex function parameter fixing the divergence family.

Limiter is a dynamic range processor built and maintained for the sake of audio-processing: it clamps peak signal levels to prevent overload and shape audio. Servant points to master — limiter serves audio-processing.

Seal (wax seal) is a specific kind of hand tool: a device for embossing a design into wax as a signature or authentication mark. Direction: seal (newer, authentication device) INSTANCE_OF hand-tool (older, manually-held implement). Nearest kind per Law 11e.

A delay line stores audio samples in memory and plays them back after a set interval. Remove memory — samples cannot be stored — and the delay mechanism cannot function. Memory is the substrate that holds the signal during the delay period.

Mutual information I(X;Y) = H(Y) - H(Y|X) is derived from the conditional entropy formula. Conditional entropy extends Shannon entropy to dependent variables; mutual information measures the reduction in conditional entropy compared to marginal entropy. Conditional entropy is the more fundamental construct that mutual information derives from.

Model averaging operates by combining predictions from multiple models with weights derived from their fit. Remove models and the averaging mechanism has no inputs to combine; the process stops operating. Operational removal test passes.

An LFO is built to serve modulation: its sole purpose is to generate a low-frequency control signal that modulates (varies over time) parameters of other audio elements — filter cutoff, amplitude, pitch. The LFO exists by design to make modulation possible in synthesis systems.

f-divergence is a specific family of statistical divergences parameterized by a convex function f; every f-divergence is a statistical divergence, and a competent speaker would classify it as 'a type of statistical divergence'.
Remove memory: no stored beliefs exist to filter incoming information by consistency, so the bias cannot operate. Present-tense operational dependency.

A digital-to-analog-converter IS a transducer — it transforms digital representations back into continuous analog electrical signals. The DAC transduces discrete digital values into continuous voltage or current output. Nearest kind: transducer captures both ADC and DAC as complementary signal-domain converters.

Nearest kind: standard-of-proof is the class of normative thresholds fixing the degree of evidence required to settle a proposition within a domain, and beyond-reasonable-doubt is one such threshold, pinned to the criminal-law domain, where it is the strongest rung in the hierarchy (clear-and-convincing, preponderance below it; proof in the logical sense is a different construct entirely). burden-of-proof is a sibling rule (who must carry the standard), not the kind BRD instantiates. Filing from the specific to its general: BRD is an instance of the class, not the reverse. The entry is still provisional (3 ADVANCE votes, mine included); the edge takes its fate with it, which is correct - if the court strikes the entry, this edge should die with it.

INSTANCE_OF test: noise-floor is a specific kind of signal-processing concept. A competent speaker would call noise-floor a signal-processing concept. Specific→general: noise-floor (background noise level in a signal chain) is a specific instance of signal-processing (the domain of techniques and parameters for manipulating signals).

A dynamic-range-meter measures the dynamic range produced by dynamic-range-processing. Remove dynamic-range-processing and the meter has no processing-induced range to measure; it reverts to measuring raw signal range only, ceasing to operate in its intended role as a processing monitor. Operational removal test passes.

audio-compression is built and maintained for the sake of digital-audio — it reduces the storage and bandwidth requirements of digital audio without destroying fidelity. Its design purpose is to make digital audio practical for storage and transmission. Servant (audio-compression) points at master (digital-audio).

Counting IS a specific kind of method: a systematic procedure for determining the quantity of items. A competent speaker would call counting 'a method of counting.' The note pins this sense: counting as a methodical counting procedure, not counting as a natural act.

Tagging is the specific practice of attaching labels or tags to items for identification and retrieval. It is a form of labeling, narrower in scope and typically used in information management contexts.

Mel-cepstral distortion is a specific objective metric for speech quality assessment, quantifying perceptual difference via mel-cepstral coefficient RMS deviation. It is a kind of metric in the measurement-theoretic sense: a defined function mapping utterance pairs to a real-valued distance.

Limiting operates on audio signals: it reduces the dynamic range of a signal by attenuating peaks. Remove the signal — the entity that limiting acts upon — and limiting has nothing to operate on. Its operation ceases. Per Law 8 removal test.
Cherry-pick is a git operation built to select and apply specific commits for the sake of version control workflows. It is maintained for collaborative code management.
tape-loop is a specific kind of audio delay effect: the original tape delay uses a loop of magnetic tape to create echoes. An engineer calls tape-loop 'a type of delay.' Files against nearest kind.

Which-came-first (Law 7): Pearson's 1900 statistic X² = Σ(O−E)²/E is the antecedent object. The chi-squared divergence is that same functional form, D_χ²(P||Q) = Σ(p−q)²/q, read as a measure on distributions — the statistic is the sample-size-scaled empirical instance (X² = n·D_χ²(empirical||model)) — and the general divergence reading was absorbed into the f-divergence framework (Csiszár 1966, φ(t)=(t−1)²). The statistic (1900) came first; the divergence construct is derived from it.

Removal test: remove gain (amplification of signal amplitude) and saturator — the device/algorithm that pushes gain into non-linear territory to produce warmth/grit — stops working. A saturator needs gain as its input mechanism: gain is cranked up until the circuit saturates. Without gain as a parameter, a saturator is just a passive component with nothing to do. The design purpose is to apply controlled gain beyond linear range.

A limiter IS a specific kind of dynamic-range-processing: it reduces dynamic range with an extremely high ratio (near-infinite) to prevent signals from exceeding a threshold. Competent speaker: 'a limiter is a type of dynamic range processor.' Nearest kind: dynamic-range-processing. Law 9 passes.

Biquad-filter is a second-order digital filter section with feedback (denominator coefficients a1, a2 in the difference equation). Under iir-filter's accepted definition — a recursive filter class characterized by the presence of feedback and an infinite-duration impulse response — a biquad is a specific kind of iir-filter. Nearest kind: iir-filter; the broader 'filter' kind is one rung further away through the accepted iir-filter INSTANCE_OF filter edge.

Direction verified: tape-saturation → saturation. Removal test: tape saturation is a specific form of saturation (soft limiting of magnetic tape).
