Overdrive is a specific kind of audio effect — a signal-processing technique that modifies timbre through soft clipping. A competent speaker calls overdrive 'an audio effect' (Law 9). Pinned sense: overdrive as an audio effect category, not as amplifier failure or circuit damage.

anti-aliasing IS a specific kind of signal-processing technique — it prevents high-frequency components from folding into lower frequencies during sampling. The nearest kind is signal-processing: operations on signals. Direction is specific→general.

Differential entropy is the continuous analog of Shannon (discrete) entropy, replacing summation with integration over a probability density. It was derived from Shannon entropy to handle continuous distributions — entropy came first and gives rise to differential entropy as its continuous extension.

An LFO generates oscillatory waveforms at low frequencies. Remove the concept of oscillation (periodic variation around equilibrium) and an LFO ceases to operate — its entire purpose is to produce controlled oscillation. Removal test passes: present-tense functional dependency.

A colophon is a paratextual statement placed at or near the end of a book or codex that records production details. It is a physical marker embedded IN a book — its meaning and function derive from being part of a book's paratextual apparatus. Remove books as the container, and a colophon ceases to operate as a document feature. Direction: colophon→book.

Rumour requires the gossip mechanism to propagate — unverified claims spread through informal social gossip. Remove the gossip mechanism and rumour cannot operate or persist. The dependency is at the operational level: rumour is a content type that gossip is the transport for.

A thesaurus is a specific kind of dictionary that organizes words by semantic relationships (synonyms and antonyms) rather than alphabetically by headword definitions. A competent speaker calls a thesaurus a type of dictionary.

Audio dithering is built and maintained for the sake of audio processing: it decorrelates quantization error and prevents distortion artifacts during bit-depth reduction in audio signal chains, enabling cleaner processing in recording and mastering. For whose sake? Audio processing benefits from dithering's error reduction.

An index is built specifically to enable retrieval — its design purpose is to make it possible to find information by organizing entry points to content. For whose sake? Retrieval. The index points at retrieval as its master.

Remove synthesis and digital-audio cannot operate — digital audio as a discipline of sound creation and manipulation fundamentally depends on synthesis techniques (subtractive, FM, wavetable, granular) as its core methodology. Without synthesis, digital audio loses its creative engine.

A digital-to-analog-converter is built and maintained for the sake of audio engineering practice: it converts digital audio data to analog waveforms for monitoring, mixing, mastering, and playback. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

Comparator is built and maintained for the sake of audio engineering practice: in dynamics processing it compares audio signals against thresholds to trigger gain reduction, gating, limiting, and sidechain control. The device's purpose is to serve engineering decisions about level and dynamics in the audio domain, not merely to exist as a generic electronic component.

Pitch shifting changes the playback rate of digital audio, which is fundamentally sample-rate conversion. Remove resampling — the signal cannot be converted to the target pitch — and the pitch shifter has no mechanism to produce its output. Resampling is the core operation.

prod-flip-witness IS a specific kind of audit record — it is a mechanism for recording a state flip during production, serving as an auditable trail. The nearest kind is audit: the practice of systematic examination of records. Direction is specific→general.

Merge conflict is a specific situation within version control where concurrent changes to the same content cannot be automatically reconciled. It is a concrete instance of a version-control event/problem.

Nearest-kind filing (Law 11e) that completes the ladder left open when headphone-stand→rack was struck. The rack target's accepted carve is the MECHANICAL GEAR (toothed bar meshing with a pinion) — a homograph trap, so the holding-structure sense needed its own entry, now filed: 'stand' = a support fixture of base, arm, and contact point holding an object upright at a chosen position. Source accepted carve: 'a human-made support fixture that holds a pair of headphones by the headband or earcups when not in use' with parameters (support geometry: base + upright arm or cradle; contact: cradle or hook) — that is a stand shaped to the held-object class 'headphones', satisfying the target's four parameters (held-object class, base geometry, arm geometry, contact mechanism) exactly. Specific→general (Law 9): a headphone stand is a stand whose held object is a pair of headphones.

Tsallis divergence is defined between two probability distributions P and Q; the formula D_q(P||Q) requires the masses p_i and q_i as inputs. Removing the probability distributions eliminates the operand of the divergence, so the divergence ceases to be computable/operable. Operational cessation, not mere conceptual sayability.

Falsification is the practice of testing a claim by attempting to disprove it. It requires the scientific method's framework of hypothesis, testing, and evaluation to operate. The removal test passes: without the scientific method's structured process of hypothesis testing, falsification as an operational practice cannot function — there is no framework within which to evaluate results or establish demarcation.
minimum-phase-filter is a specific kind of filter defined by its phase property.
Conceptual metaphor is a human-authored mapping framework built and taught for the sake of making abstract domains learnable and communicable; educational practice sustains and refines it

Delay is a specific kind of audio effect: it intentionally alters a sound signal by returning discrete repeats of it (the classic echo repeats), matching the audio-effect shelf definition ('a signal processing technique or device that intentionally alters a sound signal to change its perceptual character'). The echo entry is a concept of the natural reflected-sound phenomenon, not an effect rung, so the nearest kind on the effect axis is the shelf itself — the same rung chorus, phaser, flanger, and comb-file all hold directly. Direction: specific -> general per Law 9.

A compressor adjusts the amplitude of a signal based on its level relative to a threshold, using an envelope follower and a voltage/current-controlled gain element. This IS amplitude-modulation: the signal's amplitude is being modulated by a control signal (the gain envelope). Remove amplitude-modulation and the compressor cannot operate — it has no mechanism to vary amplitude. Passes Law 8 removal test.

The score function U(θ;x) = ∂/∂θ log L(θ;x) operates on the likelihood function. Remove the likelihood and the score function has no mathematical object to differentiate — it ceases to exist. The log-likelihood is a transformation of the likelihood, but the score's fundamental dependency is on the likelihood itself.
Variance is a specific statistical measure: a human-constructed quantitative metric that summarizes dispersion of a distribution. A competent speaker would call variance 'a statistical measure'.

Mid-side processing operates as a specific configuration within a signal chain. It requires an existing signal chain to attach to — removing the signal chain concept, mid-side processing has no operational context. The signal chain provides the infrastructure; mid-side processing is a processing method applied within it.

Ring modulation IS a form of amplitude modulation where the carrier signal is suppressed and the input modulates the amplitude. Remove amplitude modulation and ring modulation has no mechanism — it operates by varying signal amplitude according to a modulating waveform.

Reverb is a specific signal processing technique that creates spatial impression through delayed reflections. Competent speaker test: reverb is a kind of signal processing. Specific→general, nearest kind.

Removal test (Laws 2b/8b): ducking's defining operation is reducing one signal's gain in RESPONSE to the presence of another. That 'another' must reach the detector through a sidechain feed — a control path routed from a source different from the processed signal. Remove the sidechain and ducking cannot trigger: it has no way to know the foreground signal is present, and collapses to ordinary static gain. The mechanism it depends on is the routing (sidechain), not the compressor it may modulate — consistent with sidechain standing as the routing technique and ducking as the dynamics purpose built on it (Law 8d territory, not SERVES: this is operational dependency, not for-whose-sake).

Cepstral peak prominence (CPP) is a specific kind of feature used in speech analysis: it measures the relative prominence of the peak in the cepstral domain that corresponds to fundamental frequency, quantifying vocal clarity. A competent speech scientist would call CPP a feature — it is one measured property extracted from cepstral analysis used to classify voice quality.

Removal test (Laws 2b/8b): limiting's accepted carve is 'a dynamics processor that automatically reduces gain when an input signal exceeds a set threshold, clamping the output to a maximum level.' The threshold is the defined crossing point its mechanism triggers on — without the threshold concept, 'exceeds' has no operative boundary: no trigger, no gain reduction, no clamping. The processor stops operating as a limiter. Consistent with accepted family precedent: limiter DEPENDS_ON threshold, compressor DEPENDS_ON threshold, noise-gate DEPENDS_ON threshold, de-essing DEPENDS_ON threshold are all on the map. Not purpose (8c): the threshold is not what the limiter is for, it is the condition its operation runs on.

A desk is a kind of furniture: a movable human-made object designed to support a specific human activity (work at a surface) through an engineered form-function relation — tabletop plus support structure, exactly the parameters furniture's accepted definition carves. Nearest-kind test: no intermediate kind sits between desk and furniture on the live ladder (furniture INSTANCE_OF tool is the next rung up). Pinned sense: desk as work-surface furniture piece.

Equity is a system of legal principles and remedies built for the sake of law — it exists to supplement formal law where rigid rules produce unjust outcomes. Its designed purpose is to further law's operation toward fairness. Servant→master: equity→law.

EM operates on a statistical model with latent variables: the E-step computes posterior over latent variables given observed data and current parameters under the model's complete-data likelihood, and the M-step maximizes expected complete-data log-likelihood with respect to model parameters. Remove the statistical model and EM has no data-generating family, no parameter space, no latent structure to optimize — the iterative procedure stops operating entirely.

AIC is designed to estimate prediction error and is used by design as a weighting criterion in model averaging. Its purpose in this context is to serve model averaging's operation by providing model weights — Akaike weights are derived directly from AIC differences.

Remove sample-clock now — biquad-filter stops operating: the filter computes y[n] per input sample driven by the sample clock; without the clock no samples arrive and the difference equation cannot be evaluated. The removal test shows operational dependence, not historical association.

Ring modulator derives from frequency modulation: it multiplies signals to produce sum/difference frequencies, which is a specific frequency-shifting technique derived from the broader FM concept. Direction: ring-modulator (newer, 1930s-40s electronic technique) DERIVED_FROM frequency-modulation (older, foundational signal processing concept).

Butterworth filter operates as a digital/analog signal processing filter; removing signal processing capability stops it from operating. The filter's computation (frequency response evaluation, pole placement) requires signal processing operations.

A preamp requires power to operate — it cannot amplify a signal without electrical power to drive its active components (transistors, op-amps, vacuum tubes). Remove power and the preamp is inert. This is a constitutive dependency: the removal test passes — without power, signal amplification ceases entirely.

ELBO was derived as a tractable lower bound ON marginal likelihood. Marginal likelihood p(x) = integral p(x|theta)pi(theta)dtheta was formalized in Bayesian statistics in the 19th century; ELBO (Jordan et al. 1999) was introduced decades later as a computable approximation. The identity log p(x) = ELBO(q) + KL(q||p) shows ELBO = log p(x) - KL: ELBO is literally derived from marginal likelihood (minus KL). Marginal likelihood came first.
Mid-side processing encodes stereo audio by computing mid = L+R and side = L-R; it operates on audio signals. Remove signal and there is nothing to encode.

tempo IS a specific kind of measurement: it quantifies the speed of a beat cycle, measured in beats per minute (BPM). A competent speaker in music would call tempo a type of measurement — specifically, a temporal rate measurement. Ladder: measurement is the nearest general kind.
Stereo is a specific kind of audio processing technique that uses multiple channels to create spatial sound; a competent speaker would call it 'a form of audio processing'

A headphone stand is a specific kind of furniture: a small movable object designed to support a human activity — keeping headphones accessible and undamaged — through engineered form-function relationship. Competent speaker would call it a piece of furniture or accessory furniture. Nearest kind: furniture is the accepted rung on the INSTANCE_OF ladder; no narrower furniture subclass is filed for headphone supports. Specific→general per Law 9/11e.

Overdrive produces its characteristic tone through soft-clipping (a form of saturation) of the input signal. Remove the saturation mechanism — the nonlinear transfer that compresses the signal peaks — and the circuit produces clean amplification, not overdrive. The specific tonal behavior of overdrive (warm harmonic enrichment, gentle compression) is parasitic on saturation.

Dialectic is a specific form of reasoning that proceeds through dialogue, opposition, and synthesis of opposing viewpoints. A competent speaker would classify dialectic as 'a kind of reasoning' — it's the structured method of reasoning by thesis-antithesis-synthesis (or via sustained argument between positions).
A rumour is a specific kind of information: unverified claims or stories circulated informally between people. A competent speaker would call a rumour a form of information.

Log-sum-exp is built and maintained for the sake of optimization: it provides a smooth, differentiable approximation to the max function, widely used in convex optimization, softargmax, and reinforcement learning value operations. The servant (log-sum-exp) points at the master (optimization).

Rhetoric as a formal discipline of persuasive speaking/writing developed from the ancient practice of using tropes (figures of speech). Tropes existed as a practice long before rhetoric was codified as an art/form. Which-came-first test: trope (0.11) predates rhetoric (0.29).
Cepstral peak prominence quantifies periodicity and is built for the sake of voiced/unvoiced discrimination, a core input to voice-activity-detection pipelines. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

Syllogism is a deductive reasoning form that depends on deduction operating — premises are evaluated through deductive inference to produce a conclusion. Without deduction providing the inference mechanism, syllogism cannot derive conclusions from premises. Constitutive: the deductive inference is what makes a syllogism operate.

Law 8 removal test, operational not meta: an information criterion scores a fitted statistical model — its input is a model with a maximized log-likelihood and a count of free parameters. Remove statistical models NOW and there is nothing to score: the scoring, comparing, and selecting operations have no object and stop operating, not merely stop being sayable (Law 2b). Not identity (Law 8c): a criterion is not a model, it is a rule that operates on models; the model is an essential argument of the function, as in the parallel AIC and log-likelihood cases.

A deposition is a specific kind of discovery: in adversarial litigation, discovery is the pretrial phase made up of the information-exchange devices — interrogatories, requests for production, requests for admission, and depositions — and a deposition is one of those standard devices. A competent practitioner calls a deposition 'a discovery tool'; the Law 9 test (is X a specific kind of Y?) passes. Sense pinned per Law 11d: the deposition as the sworn out-of-court witness-examination device of civil and criminal procedure, not the transcript-as-evidence sense (that would relate to evidence, a different claim). Nearest kind: discovery, not law — filing against law would be a ladder leap.

A rumour is information spread through informal channels. Remove communication and a rumour cannot propagate — it has no mechanism to move from person to person. The concept of a rumour as social information inherently depends on the existence of communication as the channel through which it travels.

Signal-chain IS a specific kind of audio processing: it is a conceptual model representing the ordered sequence of processing stages through which audio passes. A competent speaker would call a signal-chain 'an audio processing model/route.' Nearest kind is audio-processing. Pinned sense (Law 11d): audio-processing as the organized practice of transforming audio signals through stages.

Cepstral peak prominence is designed and maintained for the sake of speech-processing: it quantifies vocal clarity by measuring the relative prominence of the cepstral peak corresponding to fundamental frequency. Without speech-processing applications (voice quality assessment, prosody analysis, pathology detection), cepstral-peak-prominence would have no reason to be computed or maintained — its entire purpose is to serve speech analysis systems.

Law 8d servant points at master. The score function (gradient of the log-likelihood in the parameters) is constructed for the sake of MLE: its zeros locate the maximum-likelihood estimate, and its variance yields the Fisher information that underlies the MLE's asymptotic normality and efficiency. The master's own accepted definition names the purpose: the score function 'is a key tool in MLE' — purpose named in the source definition. The score serves the estimator; the estimator is not built for the score's sake.

parallel-compression needs compression to operate: the technique blends a dry signal with a compressed signal. Remove compression and parallel compression cannot function — there is no compressed signal to blend. The removal test passes.

A bit depth IS a specific kind of measurement: the number of bits per sample in digital audio, quantifying quantization precision. A competent speaker calls bit depth 'a measurement' — it measures resolution.

A saturator operates by applying a nonlinear transfer function to an audio signal — this IS waveshaping. Remove waveshaping (nonlinear waveform transformation) and a saturator has no mechanism: it cannot add harmonics without shaping the waveform through a nonlinear curve.

A clipper IS a specific kind of limiter: it limits signal amplitude by harshly cutting (clipping) peaks at or above a threshold, as opposed to compression or limiting which reduce gain gradually. A competent audio engineer recognizes a clipper as a type of amplitude limiter.

Bit-crusher is a specific kind of audio effect: it intentionally alters a sound signal by reducing bit depth and sample rate to produce quantization noise and lo-fi timbral distortion. A competent audio engineer calls a bit-crusher 'an audio effect'. Nearest kind per Law 11e is audio-effect.

Signal-amplification is a specific kind of signal-processing: it processes signals by increasing their amplitude. Nearest kind: signal-processing is the general class of operations that modify signals. Competent speaker: signal-amplification is a type of signal processing. Law 9 passes. Not DEPENDS_ON — it is a kind, not a requirement.

Mel-cepstral distortion is a metric built and maintained for the sake of audio processing practice: it quantifies spectral distortion between reference and synthesized speech for voice conversion and codec evaluation, used in research and product testing. Servant→master per Law 8d.

Reverb simulates the acoustic space around a sound by creating dense, decaying repetitions of the original signal. These repetitions are produced by delay-lines (short delays with feedback). Remove delay-line and reverb has no mechanism — all reverb algorithms (convolution, algorithmic, digital) fundamentally use delay-lines as their building blocks. The which-came-first test passes: delay-line (epoch 0) predates reverb (epoch 0.11).

A comb-filter IS a specific kind of filter: it selectively passes or attenuates frequency components via a designed transfer function whose magnitude response is periodic in frequency (equally spaced peaks and nulls, comb-shaped), realized by delay-and-add. The accepted filter definition — 'selectively passes or attenuates frequency components based on a designed transfer function' — is exactly the genus, and the comb's periodic transfer function is the species. Nearest kind: the map has fir-filter, iir-filter, and all-pass-filter as specific rungs, but a basic comb (y[n]=x[n]+g·x[n-D]) is FIR while a feedback comb is IIR, so neither specific rung covers the construct; 'filter' is the nearest kind that does. Direction: specific→general (Law 9).

isomorphism DEPENDS_ON abstraction: an isomorphism is a structure-preserving map between abstract objects. The very notion of isomorphism requires abstraction — stripping away irrelevant details to focus on structural correspondence. Remove abstraction and isomorphism ceases to be a meaningful concept, as it operates entirely at the level of abstract structural relations.

Typology is a systematic classification scheme whose very mechanism is linguistic categorization. The types, their boundaries, and their relationships are defined through language. Remove language and typology cannot operate — classification requires categories named and related through linguistic structure. Object-level: the mechanism is language, not merely discussed via language.

Idealization is a specific kind of simplification used in scientific modeling: deliberately omitting or altering complexity to make a system tractable. A competent speaker calls idealization a type of simplification. Nearest kind: simplification.

Begging the question depends on logic: the fallacy is defined within logical reasoning — assuming what should be proven. Remove logic and the concept has no operational meaning; the test of circularity only exists within logical frameworks. Object-level dependency on the domain that gives it meaning.

A notion requires categorization to operate — to form a notion is to distinguish a concept from its surroundings, which is categorization. Constitutive removal test: remove categorization and notions cease to operate. This is a constitutive dependency, not just incidental use.

The exponential family is a class of probability distributions defined by a specific mathematical form. It operates within probability theory — without the framework of probability distributions, the exponential family has no structure to operate within. The removal test: removing probability theory eliminates the mathematical framework that defines the exponential family's persistence.

A chorus effect cannot operate without delaying copies of the input signal: the core mechanism creates multiple copies, shifts each copy's playback timing by 15–40 ms, varies that offset with an LFO, and mixes the copies back with the original. Remove delay-line and chorus ceases to function — not merely become unsayable.

A morphism is a structure-preserving map between objects, a construct built and maintained for the sake of mathematics — it serves mathematical reasoning about structure. Servant (morphism) points at master (mathematics).

Canonical references, standards, and authoritative forms serve retrieval — they provide trusted, indexed, and easily locatable information. A canonical entry in a knowledge base is designed to be found and relied upon. Servant→master per Law 8d.

Sample-and-hold is a circuit technique built for audio engineering: captures and holds analog signal values for precise A/D conversion in recording and synthesis. Law 8d: servant (sample-and-hold) → master (audio engineering).

Phase vocoder is a signal processing technique built and maintained for the sake of audio processing: it modifies duration without changing pitch, enabling time-stretching and pitch-shifting applications. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

The FIR filter is a digital filter type specifically designed for signal processing — its purpose is to implement linear-phase filtering in signal processing pipelines. Servant (fir-filter) points at master (signal-processing).

A stipulation is a specific type of rule — a condition or requirement prescribed by authority in a particular context (legal, contractual, procedural). The nearest general kind is rule (a prescribed guideline for behavior or procedure). Direction: stipulation (specific) → rule (general).

Conditional entropy measures remaining uncertainty given observed features. In pattern recognition, it serves as the foundational metric for mutual information computation, enabling feature selection algorithms that identify which features reduce class-uncertainty most effectively.

Notions require categorization to operate — a notion IS a categorized concept in the mind. Remove categorization and notions cease to exist as organized cognitive units. Constitutive removal test passes: without the capacity to categorize, there are no notions, only undifferentiated impressions.

Flangers require signal-processing to operate: they mix a signal with a time-delayed copy and apply modulation, all of which are signal-processing operations. Remove signal-processing and the flanger mechanism stops working entirely. The removal test passes.

Removal test: remove clipping (signal distortion that occurs when an amplifier's output exceeds its maximum capacity) and headroom — the margin between normal operating level and the point where clipping occurs — loses its meaning entirely. Headroom is defined as the buffer before clipping; without the clipping threshold, headroom has no referent. Clipping is the ceiling; headroom is the distance to it.

gain-staging sets optimal signal levels across a chain to maximize fidelity. Remove signal-processing and gain-staging cannot operate — it has no mechanism without signal analysis and adjustment. Present-tense dependency.

Stare decisis (precedent) is a legal doctrine built for the sake of law — it exists to ensure consistency and predictability in legal outcomes. Its purpose is to further law's operation through reasoned continuity. Servant→master.

Stereo reproduction depends on audio-processing to operate: two-channel separation, panning, and spatial image creation are all audio-processing operations. Remove audio-processing and stereo as a functional practice stops working — it's not merely sayable, it's operationally dependent.
Audio effects are built and maintained for the sake of audio processing: they are the implementations of DSP algorithms that process audio signals. Servant points at master.

hegemony IS a specific kind of influence. Its accepted definition carves it as 'a form of social power in which a dominant group secures voluntary cooperation of a ruled population through cultural norm diffusion.' Hegemony is a particular mechanism of social influence — the specific kind where dominance is maintained through consent rather than coercion. A competent speaker would call it 'a kind of influence.'

A new sustainability initiative or approach is a specific kind of sustainability effort — one that introduces novel methods or frameworks for sustainable practice. A competent speaker would call new-sustainability a type of sustainability.

User feedback is built for the purpose of driving iteration — it informs design improvements, feature refinements, and product cycles. The feedback loop exists to enable iteration. Servant→master per Law 8d.

Both negativity-bias and availability-heuristic are concepts in the same family of cognitive biases/heuristics described by Kahneman and Tversky. Negativity bias (the tendency for negative stimuli to have greater psychological impact) emerged in the psychological literature before availability heuristic (judging frequency by ease of recall), and they share a common theoretical origin in judgment-and-decision-research. The former's research tradition influenced the latter's development.

Tsallis divergence shares the power-divergence building block Σ p^α q^(1-α): Tsallis applies (1/(α-1))(1 - Σ p^α q^(1-α)) while power divergence uses (1/(α(α-1))) Σ(p^α q^(1-α) - ...). Both are transformations of the same underlying power kernel.

A butterworth filter is an electronic filter whose operation depends on signal processing techniques — specifically, frequency-domain analysis and transfer function computation. Remove signal-processing (mathematical analysis and transformation of signals) and the filter cannot be designed or implemented: its cutoff characteristic, rolloff behavior, and passband flatness all require signal processing machinery to operate. This is not merely 'is a type of' — the butterworth filter's mechanism requires signal processing as a prerequisite.

A curse is a speech act invoked for the purpose of invoking harm or misfortune, and it is built and maintained within religious and ritual contexts for the sake of religious practice — prayer, exorcism, blessing, and ritual protection. Its designed purpose is to further religious operations. The servant (curse) points at the master (religion).
Isomorphism requires mathematical structures to operate — group theory, ring theory, category theory. Removing mathematics removes the structures that isomorphism relates. Present-tense dependency.

Availability heuristic was coined by Tversky and Kahneman 1973 as a specific type of heuristic — a mental shortcut for judging probability and frequency. Under Law 7, which-came-first: the general concept of heuristic predates the specific availability heuristic. The heuristic is a mental shortcut; availability heuristic is a specific named heuristic derived from the broader heuristic concept.

A provider-turn is a specific kind of protocol in AI/ML systems — the mechanism by which a model provider shifts to a new model version. Law 9 test passes: a competent speaker would call a provider-turn a kind of protocol.

Formant-preserving pitch shift is a technique built for the sake of altering pitch while preserving formant structure in sound. It serves sound processing practice by enabling pitch manipulation without the 'chipmunk effect' — maintained for the quality of results in audio production.

gain-staging needs headroom to operate: the entire practice of managing signal levels depends on having headroom to work with. Remove headroom and gain-staging cannot function — there is nothing to manage. The removal test passes.

Digital audio is a system for representing and processing audio as discrete digital signals. The removal test: remove signals and digital audio ceases to operate — it has nothing to process. This is an object-level dependency: digital audio is fundamentally about signal manipulation, not a meta-level conceptual dependence.

Compression (in audio, the process of reducing dynamic range) DEPENDS_ON gain: the removal test passes — compression operates by reducing gain (gain reduction) when the signal exceeds a threshold. Remove gain, and compression ceases to operate because gain reduction is the core mechanism; without gain there is no lever for compression to act on.

The preamp's accepted definition is 'a human-made electronic circuit whose purpose is to increase the amplitude of a weak input signal to a line-level or suitable operating level' — that is precisely the process of signal amplification, and its first parameter is 'input gain — the amplification factor applied.' Removal test: take the technique of scaling a signal's amplitude with external power out of the world and the preamp has no operation; it becomes an unpowered junction. Present-tense operational necessity (Law 8b), not chronology. Note: the companion pending edges filed against 'amplification' mis-targeted the Rhetorical holder; this edge points at the live entry that actually holds the electrical sense.

Speech intelligibility measures how well speech is understood by human listeners — a perceptual metric grounded in how the auditory system processes sound. Remove psychoacoustics (the study of sound perception) and the concept of intelligibility as a perceptual measure collapses into mere acoustic clarity. The metric's meaning depends on psychoacoustic perception.

Overdrive is a type of amplifier — specifically one driven beyond its nominal operating range to produce intentional distortion. A competent speaker recognizes overdrive as a subclass of amplifier in audio electronics.

Power divergence D_alpha(P||Q) = (1/(alpha(alpha-1))) sum(p^alpha q^(1-alpha) - ...) is a functional of two probability distributions P and Q. Remove probability distributions and the divergence has no operands. Operational cessation per Law 8b.

A prod-flip-witness is a specific type of record that documents and verifies the transition from the pre-flip to the post-flip Systema state. It is a kind of record — the nearest accepted kind. Sense pinned: prod-flip-witness as a record of system-state transition, not as a physical object or abstract concept.

Limen describes a threshold property of the perception system — the minimum stimulus detectable. Remove the concept of perception, and limen loses its referent entirely. This is an object-level dependency (perception as a concept), not meta-level (Law 2b). Direction: limen→perception per Law 8.

Subwoofer is built and maintained for the sake of audio engineering practice: it provides dedicated low-frequency reproduction for mixing, mastering, and playback, enabling full-range monitoring and sound design. Servant points at master per Law 8d.
An incipit is the opening words or phrase of a written work; it depends on the book (or manuscript) for its existence — the incipit is a part of the text, not a standalone construct.

Tape saturation is a specific kind of distortion: its defining sonic content — soft clipping, even-order harmonic generation, level-dependent compression (the 'warmth' archetype) — sits inside the carve of distortion's accepted definition ('clipping (hard or soft) that generates new harmonic and subharmonic frequencies... grit, warmth'), and its persistence as a digital algorithm (waveshaping, convolution of impulse responses) is an implementation class distortion's definition explicitly names. Nearest kind per Law 11e is distortion, not the audio-effect shelf (where the accepted tape-saturation->audio-effect leap will retire as SUBSUMED once this rung stands). Direction: specific (tape-saturation) -> general (distortion), Law 9.

Upward expansion is a specific kind of audio effect: it intentionally alters a sound signal by increasing gain below a threshold, changing perceptual character. A competent audio engineer would call upward expansion an audio effect. Nearest kind per Law 11e is audio-effect.

A pitch-shifter is a specific kind of audio-effect: it alters sound by changing its pitch while preserving duration. A competent audio engineer would call a pitch-shifter 'an audio effect.' Pin sense: the audio effect that shifts fundamental frequency without time alteration.

Fisher information I(θ) = E[(∂/∂θ log p(x|θ))²] is defined from the log-likelihood of a statistical model. Remove the statistical model (the probability family p(x|θ)) and Fisher information has no mathematical object to operate on — it ceases to exist operationally.

comb-filter is a specific audio effect that creates a series of regular peaks and notches in the frequency response (resembling a comb) through constructive and destructive interference of a signal with delayed copies of itself.

The phase-locked vocoder is a speech analysis-synthesis technique that uses phase-locked loops to track and model speech signal components. It depends on speech-processing — without speech processing theory and techniques for analysis and synthesis, the phase-locked vocoder has no operational framework.

Socks are worn for the sake of clothing: they provide foot coverage as part of a garment ensemble, fulfilling both functional (protection, warmth) and aesthetic purposes within the domain of clothing.

Law 8d servant->master: PDP's accepted definition carves it as 'a diagnostic visualization in machine learning model interpretability that reveals the marginal effect of a single feature on the predicted outcome of a trained model' — a feature-attribution technique of the interpretability family. Model interpretability's accepted definition names exactly this family ('feature attribution, surrogate modeling, activation analysis, attention visualization'), and the board already routes the family's members to it: feature importance —SERVES-> model interpretability, chain of thought —SERVES-> model interpretability (both accepted). Removing interpretability as the beneficiary: the plot's reason for existing — decoding how the trained model responds to a feature — ceases to be served; the plot is built for the sake of understanding the model, and model interpretability is the nearest standing master, not the whole field. Pinned sense: the interpretability family as carved by its accepted definition.

Falsification is a specific kind of criterion used to evaluate scientific claims. A competent speaker would say 'falsification is a criterion' — it provides a standard (can the claim be shown false?) against which theories are judged. The nearest kind is criterion, not the broader practice or method.

Arbitration is a dispute-resolution mechanism built and maintained for the sake of law. Its designed purpose is to further legal resolution outside (or alongside) formal courts. The arrow points from servant (arbitration) to master (law).

A crossover splits an audio signal into separate frequency bands using filters. Its operation fundamentally depends on frequency-domain analysis and transformation — the fourier-transform provides the mathematical basis for identifying and separating frequency components. Without Fourier analysis (or equivalent frequency-domain methods), a crossover cannot operate: you cannot separate by frequency without a frequency-domain representation.

CPP extracts periodicity features from speech signals, and these features are consumed by digital-audio applications — voice conversion, speech synthesis, and pitch manipulation all depend on CPP extraction. Remove CPP and these audio processing pipelines lose a core feature, though they still operate with alternative features.

A sufficient statistic is constructed for the sake of data reduction without loss of information for parameter estimation. It exists to serve estimation by summarizing the sample into a minimal statistic that retains all inferential content about θ, enabling Rao-Blackwell improvement and uniformly most powerful tests. Servant points at master estimation.

Digital and physical reverb implementations rely on delay lines to create reflections and diffusion. Remove delay-line construct and reverb's core mechanism of storing and releasing reflections with time offset vanishes. Removal test passes at object level.

A phase-locked loop is a control system that locks onto a reference signal's phase by feeding its own output back through a phase detector for comparison. Without the feedback path, the VCO runs free and the loop cannot lock — removing feedback means the PLL stops operating entirely.
Estoppel is a specific legal principle that prevents a party from asserting something contrary to a representation previously made. A competent speaker would call estoppel a legal principle.

Nearest kind (Law 9/11e): stereotype's definition pins it as 'a standardized mental category that maps a social group onto a fixed set of attributes' — the head noun is category, and category's accepted parameters (a human-made bucket grouping entities by shared properties, with a set of items and shared features) fit: a stereotype groups a social group by fixed attributes. Not heuristic: heuristic's definition requires a 'problem-solving strategy' trading correctness for speed — a stereotype is a social-cognition shortcut, not a problem-solving procedure; the mechanism clause is the operation, not the kind. Not cognitive-strategy: that requires 'deliberately designed' procedure, and stereotypes are not deliberately designed.

Law 8d servant→master device: the sample-and-hold exists to hold a stable value for the ADC's conversion stage — the accepted ADC definition names 'sampling via a track-and-hold circuit' as its own stage 2, and the S/H's accepted definition says it persists through implementation in analog-to-digital converters. Built for whose sake? The converter: without the hold, the (slower) quantization stage would measure a moving voltage. Pinned sense: S/H as the ADC's sampling stage, servant pointing at its master device (not the discipline, which is already covered by the ADC's own SERVES audio-engineering edge). Distinct from its accepted INSTANCE_OF sampling and DEPENDS_ON signal.

garden-tool is a kind of hand-tool: its accepted definition distinguishes the class from agricultural machinery BY manual operation ('distinguished from agricultural machinery by manual operation and small-scale applicability'), and every member (hoes, trowels, secateurs) has the hand as prime mover — hand-scaled graspable form, working end shaped for the task, force applied by grip/push/pull/chop. Pinned sense: class-level kind relation — the garden-tool class sits within the hand-powered implement class. Law 9 specific->general; nearest-kind test: hand-tool is the nearest existing general class above garden-tool (no intermediate 'manually-operated-tool' rung exists in the record).

Conceptual metaphor is a theory that humans understand abstract concepts through mappings from concrete source domains. Under Law 7, which-came-first: the general concept of metaphor (linguistic/rhetorical device) predates conceptual metaphor (cognitive theory) by millennia. The conceptual theory is derived from the broader metaphor concept, extending it from language to cognition.

For whose sake: feedback is designed and maintained for audio-engineering, creating controlled self-oscillation, Leslie-style modulation, and guitar-amplifier tones in mixing and live sound. Servant→master.

A comb-filter is a specific signal processing technique. Remove signal-processing as the computational framework, and the comb-filter cannot operate — its entire mechanism (delay, superposition, frequency-domain behavior) is signal processing. This passes the removal test: without signal processing, the comb-filter ceases to exist.

Windowed-sinc-interpolation is a specific interpolation method that uses a windowed sinc kernel. A competent speaker would call it 'an interpolation method/technique.' INSTANCE_OF correct: specific technique → general class.

rubicon IS a specific kind of boundary: it denotes a point of no return — a critical threshold that, once crossed, cannot be undone. In both literal (the river Rubicon) and figurative senses, it IS a boundary — specifically an irreversible one. A competent speaker would call a rubicon a type of boundary. Nearest kind: boundary.
An insert effect IS a specific kind of signal-processing: it processes a signal at a single point in an audio chain. Competent speakers would call it a form of signal processing.

Wiener filter is an optimal linear estimator built for the sake of noise reduction and signal estimation in speech processing pipelines. Its designed purpose is to further speech enhancement operation by minimizing mean-squared error. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

Gain DEPENDS_ON amplification: the removal test passes — remove the concept of amplification (the process of increasing signal amplitude), and gain ceases to operate because gain is precisely the quantitative measure of amplification. Without amplification as the referent, gain has no operational meaning.
Clock drift manifests as timing error in sample intervals; without audio samples being generated and timed, drift has no operational effect. Removing samples stops drift from operating.

Law 8d servant points at master. Pearson's chi-squared statistic is the decision quantity of the chi-squared test: compute X^2 from observed vs expected counts, compare against its asymptotic chi-squared reference distribution, decide about H0. Its accepted scope names the purpose — 'the standard form of the chi-squared hypothesis test' — and the master's own accepted definition names the chi-squared test among its operationalized standard procedures, with 'test statistic' as an explicit parameter slot. The statistic was made for the test's decision; the test is not built for the statistic's sake.

Remove signal-processing and a flanger cannot operate — it works by mixing a delayed copy of a signal with the original, a time-domain manipulation that requires signal-processing infrastructure. The delay-line sweep mechanism is itself a signal-processing technique.

Sample-and-hold circuits are built and maintained for the sake of audio engineering practice: they capture instantaneous audio signal values for sampling, ADC front ends, and test equipment. Servant points at master per Law 8d.
Cepstral peak picking operates on the cepstrum produced by cepstral analysis to locate pitch peaks; without the analysis output there is no cepstrum to inspect.

Removal test passes on the target's accepted def: headroom is 'the margin between a system's nominal operating level and its maximum capacity', with 'the type of limiting applied' as its own named parameter. threshold's def is 'a defined point of crossing that mediates between two states or spaces'. Headroom is a margin measured against exactly such a defined boundary point (nominal-vs-limit states); remove the concept of a defined crossing point and headroom's definition has nothing to be a margin of — 'maximum capacity' is a limit, i.e. a threshold. This is the same shape as compressor DEPENDS_ON threshold (operation defined against its governing boundary). I struck headroom DEPENDS_ON clipping and INSTANCE_OF saturation on 09-09 for pinning one limiting type or the limiting STATE, when headroom's dependency is the boundary concept itself. Pinned sense matches threshold's accepted def (Law 11d).

Bit-crusher is a specific kind of distortion effect: it reduces bit depth and sample rate to produce quantization noise and aliasing, which are forms of harmonic distortion. A competent audio engineer would classify bit-crusher as a type of distortion effect, alongside overdrive, fuzz, and clipper. Nearest-kind INSTANCE_OF.

Overdrive is created by driving an amplifier circuit beyond its linear operating range, producing soft clipping. The amplifier is the device that gets overdriven; without amplifiers there is no way to overdrive a circuit — the concept and the effect collapse together. Removal test: remove amplifier (the concept of an electronic circuit that increases signal amplitude) and overdrive becomes unintelligible — there is no 'over-' without an amplifier to over-drive. Pinned sense: amplifier as the amplification circuit being driven into saturation.
